//// blueprints/auto-complete.d.ts
import { BaseElementClasses, BaseElementEmits, BaseElementExpose, BaseElementParts, BaseElementProps, BaseElementSlots, DefineEvents, LooseRequired, AriaProps, AddonsProps, IconsProps, ExpressionProps, ValidationProps, AddonableProps, DisabledProps, PlaceholderProps, LoadingProps, LayoutProps, ModelEmits, InteractionEmits, ValidationEmits, InputEmits, MultipleProps, ModelApi } from '@vueform/core';
import { ForwardedEmits } from '../types';
import { AutoCompleteProps as AAutoCompleteProps, AutoCompleteEmitsOptions as AAutoCompleteEmits, AutoCompleteChangeEvent, AutoCompleteCompleteEvent } from 'primevue/autocomplete';
import { ModelPropsWithDefaultValue, FloatLabelProps, IftaLabelProps, InfoProps, SuggestionsProps, SuggestionsProp, OptionsModelProp } from '../features';
/**
 * Plain props type for the auto-complete element blueprint — the widest
 * instantiation of `AutoCompleteProps`. Use this whenever "the props of an
 * auto-complete" is meant without generic narrowing; it also serves as the
 * constraint for `blueprint` / `AutoCompleteApi` type parameters.
 */
type LooseAutoCompleteProps = AutoCompleteProps<string, SuggestionsProp, boolean>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the auto-complete element blueprint,
 * parameterized by the suggestion-driving type arguments. Reach for
 * `LooseAutoCompleteProps` instead when no narrowing is needed. There is no
 * `optionValue` — the model is the suggestion item itself.
 */
export interface AutoCompleteProps<T extends string = 'auto-complete', TSuggestions extends SuggestionsProp = SuggestionsProp, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, S = AutoCompleteSlots, P = AutoCompleteParts, C = AutoCompleteClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<OptionsModelProp<TSuggestions, undefined, undefined, TMultiple, TModel, unknown>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AddonsProps<TContext>, IconsProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, LoadingProps<TContext>, PlaceholderProps<TContext>, FloatLabelProps, IftaLabelProps, InfoProps, MultipleProps<TMultiple>, SuggestionsProps<TSuggestions, TContext>, Omit<AAutoCompleteProps, 'modelValue' | 'defaultValue' | 'name' | 'invalid' | 'fluid' | 'formControl' | 'disabled' | 'placeholder' | 'loading' | 'multiple' | 'suggestions' | 'optionLabel' | 'optionDisabled' | 'minLength'>, Pick<AAutoCompleteProps, 'minLength'> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the auto-complete element.
 */
export interface AutoCompleteEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseElementEmits<TContext>, ModelEmits<any, TContext>, InteractionEmits<TContext>, ValidationEmits<TContext>, InputEmits<AutoCompleteChangeEvent['value'], TContext>, ForwardedEmits<AAutoCompleteEmits, (typeof forwards.events)[number], TContext> {
    /**
     * Callback to invoke to search for suggestions.
     *
     * @param event Custom complete event.
     * @param context$ The component context.
     */
    complete: [event: AutoCompleteCompleteEvent, context$: TContext];
}
/**
 * Slots available in the auto-complete element blueprint.
 */
export interface AutoCompleteSlots<TContext = any> extends BaseElementSlots<TContext> {
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the auto-complete element blueprint.
 */
export interface AutoCompleteParts extends BaseElementParts {
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the auto-complete element blueprint.
 */
export interface AutoCompleteClasses extends BaseElementClasses {
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for auto-complete-based components.
 */
export interface AutoCompleteExpose extends BaseElementExpose, AutoCompleteApi {
}
/**
 * Factory API produced by the auto-complete blueprint's `blueprint` function,
 * optionally parameterized by concrete props. Prefer this over
 * `ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>` at consumer sites (Expose / Context
 * layers, extensions).
 */
export type AutoCompleteApi<TProps extends LooseAutoCompleteProps = LooseAutoCompleteProps> = ModelApi<ReturnType<typeof blueprint>, TProps>;
/**
 * PrimeVue AutoComplete events and slots to forward from the Vueform adapter to
 * the underlying PrimeVue component.
 */
export declare const forwards: {
    readonly events: readonly ["value-change", "option-select", "option-unselect", "dropdown-click", "clear", "before-show", "before-hide", "show", "hide"];
    readonly slots: readonly ["chip", "header", "footer", "option", "optiongroup", "content", "loader", "empty", "dropdownicon", "chipicon", "clearicon", "dropdown"];
};
/**
 * Builds the auto-complete factory API from resolved props and events.
 *
 * SFCs consume it via the shared composable: `useBlueprint(blueprint, props,
 * events, slots, extension?)`. Passing `blueprint` as a value lets call-site
 * inference instantiate the API at the SFC's concrete props — the only
 * alternative to a per-blueprint wrapper hosting `typeof blueprint<TProps>`,
 * since conditional-type inference on a captured factory erases its type
 * parameters to constraints (verified empirically).
 */

//// blueprints/button.d.ts
import { BaseElementClasses, BaseElementEmits, BaseElementExpose, BaseElementParts, BaseElementProps, BaseElementSlots, DefineEvents, LooseRequired, TProp, AddonableProps, DisabledProps, LoadingProps, LayoutProps, InteractionEmits, BtnEmits, BtnProps, DProp } from '@vueform/core';

/**
 * Props for the button element blueprint.
 *
 * Non-generic counterpart — no item-driving type parameters. The plain props
 * type and the props interface are the same shape.
 */
export interface ButtonProps<T extends string = 'button', S = ButtonSlots, P = ButtonParts, C = ButtonClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, LoadingProps<TContext>, InfoProps, TooltipProps, Omit<BtnProps<TContext>, 'iconPos'>, Omit<AButtonProps, 'id' | 'name' | 'type' | 'label' | 'icon' | 'loading' | 'disabled' | 'text' | 'outlined' | 'link' | 'as' | 'asChild' | 'plain' | 'fluid' | 'class' | 'style' | 'severity' | 'badge' | 'badgeSeverity' | 'onFocus' | 'onBlur' | 'onClick'> {
    /**
     * The color severity of the button.
     */
    severity?: DProp<'secondary' | 'success' | 'info' | 'warn' | 'help' | 'danger' | 'contrast', TContext>;
    /**
     * Value of the badge displayed on the button.
     */
    badge?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * Severity type of the badge.
     */
    badgeSeverity?: DProp<'secondary' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warn' | 'danger' | 'contrast', TContext>;
}

//// blueprints/cascade-select.d.ts
import { BaseElementClasses, BaseElementEmits, BaseElementExpose, BaseElementParts, BaseElementProps, BaseElementSlots, DefineEvents, LooseRequired, AriaProps, AddonsProps, IconsProps, ExpressionProps, ValidationProps, AddonableProps, DisabledProps, PlaceholderProps, LoadingProps, LayoutProps, ModelEmits, InteractionEmits, InputEmits, ValidationEmits } from '@vueform/core';
import { AllowedCascadeOptionGroupChildren, CascadeOptionGroupChildrenProp, OptionsProps, OptionsModelProp, OptionValueProp, AllowsOptionKeyProps, OptionsProp, OptionsModelApi, OptionsGenericsBrand } from '../features/options';
import { ForwardedEmits } from '../types';
import { CascadeSelectProps as ACascadeSelectProps, CascadeSelectEmitsOptions as ACascadeSelectEmits, CascadeSelectChangeEvent } from 'primevue/cascadeselect';
import { ModelPropsWithDefaultValue, FloatLabelProps, IftaLabelProps, InfoProps } from '../features';
/**
 * Plain props type for the cascade-select element blueprint — the widest
 * instantiation of `CascadeSelectProps`. Use this whenever "the props of a
 * cascade-select" is meant without generic narrowing; it also serves as the
 * constraint for `blueprint` / `CascadeSelectApi` type parameters.
 */
type LooseCascadeSelectProps = CascadeSelectProps<string, OptionsProp, OptionValueProp, CascadeOptionGroupChildrenProp>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the cascade-select element blueprint,
 * parameterized by the option-driving type arguments. Reach for
 * `LooseCascadeSelectProps` instead when no narrowing is needed.
 */
export interface CascadeSelectProps<T extends string = 'cascade-select', TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends CascadeOptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown, S = CascadeSelectSlots, P = CascadeSelectParts, C = CascadeSelectClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<OptionsModelProp<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, false, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AddonsProps<TContext>, IconsProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, LoadingProps<TContext>, PlaceholderProps<TContext>, FloatLabelProps, IftaLabelProps, InfoProps, OptionsGenericsBrand<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TOptionValueReturn>, Omit<OptionsProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, any, TOptionValueReturn, TContext>, 'optionGroupChildren'>, Omit<ACascadeSelectProps, 'modelValue' | 'defaultValue' | 'name' | 'invalid' | 'fluid' | 'formControl' | 'disabled' | 'placeholder' | 'loading' | 'options' | 'optionLabel' | 'optionValue' | 'optionDisabled' | 'optionGroupLabel' | 'optionGroupChildren'> {
    /**
     * Resolves nested children for each cascade level. Accepts a string key, a
     * nested path array (e.g. `['states', 'cities']`), or a mapper function.
     *
     * The intersection arm infers keys into `TGroupChildren` while rejecting keys
     * missing from the group shape (the generic itself is only bounded by the
     * simple `CascadeOptionGroupChildrenProp`). The bare
     * `AllowedCascadeOptionGroupChildren` arm keeps keys assignable on the
     * defaulted schema surface where `TGroupChildren` is still `undefined`.
     */
    optionGroupChildren?: AllowsOptionKeyProps<TOptions> extends true ? (TGroupChildren & AllowedCascadeOptionGroupChildren<TOptions>) | AllowedCascadeOptionGroupChildren<TOptions> : never;
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the cascade-select element.
 */
export interface CascadeSelectEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseElementEmits<TContext>, ModelEmits<any, TContext>, InteractionEmits<TContext>, ValidationEmits<TContext>, InputEmits<CascadeSelectChangeEvent['value'], TContext>, ForwardedEmits<ACascadeSelectEmits, (typeof forwards.events)[number], TContext> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the cascade-select element blueprint.
 */

/**
 * Factory API produced by the cascade-select blueprint's `blueprint` function,
 * optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * `CascadeSelectApi<VfCascadeSelectProps<typeof options, 'id'>>`). Prefer this
 * over `ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>` at consumer sites (Expose /
 * Context layers, extensions).
 */
export type CascadeSelectApi<TProps extends LooseCascadeSelectProps = LooseCascadeSelectProps> = OptionsModelApi<ReturnType<typeof blueprint>, TProps>;
/**
 * PrimeVue CascadeSelect events and slots to forward from the Vueform adapter
 * to the underlying PrimeVue component.
 */
export declare const forwards: {
    readonly events: readonly ["value-change", "group-change", "before-show", "before-hide", "show", "hide"];
    readonly slots: readonly ["option", "value", "dropdownicon", "loadingicon", "optiongroupicon", "header", "footer", "clearicon"];
};
/**
 * Builds the cascade-select factory API from resolved props and events.

 * SFCs consume it via the shared composable: `useBlueprint(blueprint, props,
 * events, slots, extension?)`. Passing `blueprint` as a value lets call-site
 * inference instantiate the API at the SFC's concrete props — the only
 * alternative to a per-blueprint wrapper hosting `typeof blueprint<TProps>`,

/**
 * Plain props type for the checkbox-group element blueprint — the widest
 * instantiation of `CheckboxGroupProps`. Use this whenever "the props of a
 * checkbox-group" is meant without generic narrowing; it also serves as the
 * constraint for `blueprint` / `CheckboxGroupApi` type parameters.
 */
type LooseCheckboxGroupProps = CheckboxGroupProps<string, OptionsProp, OptionValueProp, OptionGroupChildrenProp>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the checkbox-group element blueprint,
 * parameterized by the option-driving type arguments. Reach for
 * `LooseCheckboxGroupProps` instead when no narrowing is needed.
 *
 * PrimeVue option prop names (`options` / `optionValue` /
 * `optionGroupChildren`) are kept via `OptionsProps`; generics use the
 * PrimeVue-named `TOptions` / `TOptionValueKey` / `TGroupChildren`.
 */
export interface CheckboxGroupProps<T extends string = 'checkbox-group', TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends OptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown, S = CheckboxGroupSlots, P = CheckboxGroupParts, C = CheckboxGroupClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<OptionsModelProp<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, true, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, ContainerProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, OptionsProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TOptionValueReturn, TContext>, StackedProps, InfoProps, AlignedProps {
}

/**

//// blueprints/checkbox.d.ts
import { BaseElementClasses, BaseElementEmits, BaseElementExpose, BaseElementParts, BaseElementProps, BaseElementSlots, DefineEvents, LooseRequired, AriaProps, ExpressionProps, AddonableProps, ValidationProps, DisabledProps, ReadonlyProps, LayoutProps, ModelEmits, InteractionEmits, InputEmits, ValidationEmits, TProp, AlignedProps, ModelApi } from '@vueform/core';
import { ForwardedEmits } from '../types';
import { CheckboxProps as ACheckboxProps, CheckboxEmitsOptions as ACheckboxEmits } from 'primevue/checkbox';
import { ModelPropsWithDefaultValue, InfoProps } from '../features';
/**
 * Checkbox model shape: the union of `trueValue` and `falseValue`.
 */
type CheckboxModelOf<TTrueValue, TFalseValue> = TTrueValue | TFalseValue;
/**
 * Model / default prop type for checkbox — `NoInfer` so `modelValue` does not
 * compete with `trueValue` / `falseValue` when inferring generics.
 */
type CheckboxModelProp<TTrueValue, TFalseValue> = NoInfer<CheckboxModelOf<TTrueValue, TFalseValue>>;
/**
 * The model value type carried by the checkbox element's wide props.
 */
type CheckboxModel = Required<CheckboxProps>['modelValue'];
/**
 * Props for the checkbox element blueprint, parameterized by the model-driving
 * type arguments (`trueValue` / `falseValue`). Plain usage (`CheckboxProps`)
 * keeps every member wide, so no separate plain-props alias is needed.
 */
export interface CheckboxProps<T extends string = 'checkbox', TTrueValue = any, TFalseValue = any, S = CheckboxSlots, P = CheckboxParts, C = CheckboxClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<CheckboxModelProp<TTrueValue, TFalseValue>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, ReadonlyProps<TContext>, InfoProps, AlignedProps, Omit<ACheckboxProps, 'modelValue' | 'defaultValue' | 'name' | 'invalid' | 'formControl' | 'disabled' | 'readonly' | 'binary' | 'trueValue' | 'falseValue' | 'indeterminate'> {
    /**
     * The value used when the checkbox is checked. Also drives one arm of the
     * model type.
     *
     * Includes a naked `boolean` arm alongside `TTrueValue` so the erased schema
     * surface (and blueprint defaults) still accept `true` / `false` literals.
     * Concrete values continue to infer into `TTrueValue`.
     */
    trueValue?: TTrueValue | boolean;
    /**
     * The value used when the checkbox is unchecked. Also drives one arm of the
     * model type.
     *
     * Includes a naked `boolean` arm alongside `TFalseValue` so the erased schema
     * surface (and blueprint defaults) still accept `true` / `false` literals.
     * Concrete values continue to infer into `TFalseValue`.
     */
    falseValue?: TFalseValue | boolean;
    /**
     * Overrides the HTML `name` attribute for the checkbox input.
     */
    checkboxName?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The label text displayed next to the checkbox.
     */
    text?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * Positions the label text relative to the checkbox (`left`, `right`, or
     * `auto`).
     */
    align?: 'left' | 'right' | 'auto';
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the checkbox element.
 */
export interface CheckboxEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseElementEmits<TContext>, ModelEmits<CheckboxModel, TContext>, ValidationEmits<TContext>, InteractionEmits<TContext>, InputEmits<CheckboxModel, TContext>, ForwardedEmits<ACheckboxEmits, (typeof forwards.events)[number], TContext> {
}

}

import { BaseElementClasses, BaseElementEmits, BaseElementExpose, BaseElementParts, BaseElementProps, BaseElementSlots, DefineEvents, LooseRequired, ColorFormat, AriaProps, ExpressionProps, ValidationProps, DisabledProps, LayoutProps, TextModel, ModelEmits, InteractionEmits, ValidationEmits, InputEmits, AddonableProps, DProp, AlignedProps } from '@vueform/core';

/**
 * Props for the color-picker element blueprint.
 *
 * Non-generic counterpart — no item-driving type parameters. The plain props
 * type and the props interface are the same shape.
 */
export interface ColorPickerProps<T extends string = 'color-picker', S = ColorPickerSlots, P = ColorPickerParts, C = ColorPickerClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<TextModel, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, InfoProps, AlignedProps, Omit<AColorPickerProps, 'modelValue' | 'defaultValue' | 'name' | 'invalid' | 'formControl' | 'disabled' | 'inputId' | 'format' | 'defaultColor'> {
    /**
     * Format to use in value binding, supported formats are `'hex'`, `'rgb'` and
     * `'hsb'`.
     */
    format?: DProp<ColorFormat>;
    /**
     * Initial color to display when value is not defined and the format is `hex`.
     */
    defaultColor?: any;
    /**
     * Initial color to display when value is not defined and the format is `rgb`.
     */
    defaultRgb?: {
        r: number;
        g: number;
        b: number;
    };
    /**
     * Initial color to display when value is not defined and the format is `hsb`.
     */
    defaultHsb?: {
        h: number;
        s: number;
        b: number;
    };
}

//// blueprints/date-picker.d.ts
import { BaseElementClasses, BaseElementEmits, BaseElementExpose, BaseElementParts, BaseElementProps, BaseElementSlots, DefineEvents, LooseRequired, AriaProps, AddonsProps, IconsProps, ExpressionProps, ValidationProps, AddonableProps, ReadonlyProps, DisabledProps, PlaceholderProps, LoadingProps, LayoutProps, TextMaybeArrayModel, ModelEmits, InteractionEmits, InputEmits, ValidationEmits, ModelApi, DProp } from '@vueform/core';
import { ComputedRef, WritableComputedRef } from 'vue';
import { ForwardedEmits } from '../types';
import { DatePickerProps as ADatePickerProps, DatePickerEmitsOptions as ADatePickerEmits } from 'primevue/datepicker';
import { ModelPropsWithDefaultValue, FloatLabelProps, IftaLabelProps, InfoProps, TooltipProps } from '../features';
/**
 * The model value type carried by the date-picker element's wide props.
 */
type DatePickerModel = Required<DatePickerProps>['modelValue'];
/**
 * Bound for the `TSelectionMode` generic of date-picker elements: one of
 * PrimeVue's date selection modes, or `undefined` when unset.
 *
 * Intentionally limited to the literal modes so a component instance's props
 * stay assignable to the component's canonical (defaulted) context.
 */
export type DatePickerSelectionModeProp = 'single' | 'multiple' | 'range' | undefined;
/**
 * Date-picker model shaped by `selectionMode`:
 *
 * - unset / `'single'` — `string | null`
 * - `'multiple'` / `'range'` — `string[]`
 * - wide union — `TextMaybeArrayModel`
 */
export type DatePickerModelOf<TSelectionMode extends DatePickerSelectionModeProp = DatePickerSelectionModeProp> = [DatePickerSelectionModeProp] extends [TSelectionMode] ? TextMaybeArrayModel : TSelectionMode extends 'multiple' | 'range' ? string[] : string | null;
/**
 * Model / default prop type for date-picker — `NoInfer` so `modelValue` does
 * not compete with `selectionMode` when inferring generics.
 */
export type DatePickerModelProp<TSelectionMode extends DatePickerSelectionModeProp = DatePickerSelectionModeProp> = NoInfer<DatePickerModelOf<TSelectionMode>>;
/**
 * Props for the date picker element blueprint, parameterized by the
 * model-driving type argument (`selectionMode`). Plain usage
 * (`DatePickerProps`) keeps every member wide, so no separate plain-props alias
 * is needed.
 */
export interface DatePickerProps<T extends string = 'date-picker', TSelectionMode extends DatePickerSelectionModeProp = DatePickerSelectionModeProp, S = DatePickerSlots, P = DatePickerParts, C = DatePickerClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<DatePickerModelProp<TSelectionMode>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AddonsProps<TContext>, IconsProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, ReadonlyProps<TContext>, LoadingProps<TContext>, PlaceholderProps<TContext>, FloatLabelProps, IftaLabelProps, InfoProps, TooltipProps, Omit<ADatePickerProps, 'modelValue' | 'defaultValue' | 'name' | 'invalid' | 'fluid' | 'formControl' | 'disabled' | 'placeholder' | 'readonly' | 'view' | 'minDate' | 'maxDate' | 'selectionMode'> {
    /**
     * **This replaces the original PrimeVue `selectionMode` prop.** Defines the
     * quantity of the selection and controls the model value shape:
     *
     * - unset / `'single'` → `string | null`
     * - `'multiple'` / `'range'` → `string[]`
     */
    selectionMode?: TSelectionMode | 'single' | 'multiple' | 'range';
    /**
     * **This replaces the original PrimeVue `minDate` prop.** The minimum
     * selectable date as a date string.
     */
    minDate?: DProp<string | Date, TContext>;
    /**
     * **This replaces the original PrimeVue `maxDate` prop.** The maximum
     * selectable date as a date string.
     */
    maxDate?: DProp<string | Date, TContext>;
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the date picker element.
 */
export interface DatePickerEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseElementEmits<TContext>, ModelEmits<DatePickerModel, TContext>, InteractionEmits<TContext>, ValidationEmits<TContext>, InputEmits<DatePickerModel, TContext>, ForwardedEmits<ADatePickerEmits, (typeof forwards.events)[number], TContext> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the date picker element blueprint.
 */
export interface DatePickerSlots<TContext = any> extends BaseElementSlots<TContext> {
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the date picker element blueprint.
 */
export interface DatePickerParts extends BaseElementParts {
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the date picker element blueprint.
 */
export interface DatePickerClasses extends BaseElementClasses {
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for date-picker-based components.
 */
export interface DatePickerExpose extends BaseElementExpose, DatePickerApi {
}
/**
 * Factory API produced by the date-picker blueprint's `blueprint` function,
 * optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * `DatePickerApi<VfDatePickerProps<'multiple'>>`). Prefer this over
 * `ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>` at consumer sites.
 */
export type DatePickerApi<TProps extends DatePickerProps<string> = DatePickerProps<string>> = ModelApi<ReturnType<typeof blueprint>, TProps>;

export interface EditorProps<T extends string = 'editor', TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp, S = EditorSlots, P = EditorParts, C = EditorClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<TranslateModelProp<TTranslate, TLanguages>, TContext>, TValidationProps<TContext>, TranslateProps<TTranslate, TLanguages>, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, ReadonlyProps<TContext>, PlaceholderProps<TContext>, InfoProps, Omit<AEditorProps, 'modelValue' | 'defaultValue' | 'name' | 'invalid' | 'formControl' | 'placeholder' | 'readonly' | 'modules'>, Pick<AEditorProps, 'modules'> {
    /**
     * Height of the editor content area. Numbers are interpreted as pixels.
     */
    editorHeight?: string | number;
    /**
     * Inline style of the container.
     */
    editorStyle?: any;
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the editor element.

export interface EditorEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseElementEmits<TContext>, ModelEmits<EditorModel, TContext>, InteractionEmits<TContext>, ValidationEmits<TContext>, InputEmits<EditorModel, TContext>, ForwardedEmits<AEditorEmits, (typeof forwards.events)[number], TContext> {
    /**
     * Callback to invoke when the quill modules are loaded.
     *
     * @param event Custom load event.
     * @param context$ The component's context instance.
     */
    editorLoad: [event: EditorLoadEvent, context$: TContext];
}

import { BaseElementClasses, BaseElementEmits, BaseElementExpose, BaseElementParts, BaseElementProps, BaseElementSlots, DefineEvents, LooseRequired, AriaProps, ValidationProps, DisabledProps, MultipleProps, LayoutProps, FileModelProp, ModelEmits, InteractionEmits, ValidationEmits, PlaceholderProps, DProp, InputEmits, ModelApi } from '@vueform/core';

/**
 * The model value type carried by the file-upload element's wide props.
 */
type FileUploadModel = Required<FileUploadProps>['modelValue'];
/**
 * Props for the file-upload element blueprint, parameterized by the
 * model-driving type argument (`multiple`). Plain usage (`FileUploadProps`)
 * keeps every member wide, so no separate plain-props alias is needed.
 *
 * - `multiple: false` — model is `File | null`
 * - `multiple: true` — model is `File[]`
 */
export interface FileUploadProps<T extends string = 'file-upload', TMultiple extends boolean = boolean, S = FileUploadSlots, P = FileUploadParts, C = FileUploadClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<FileModelProp<TMultiple>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, MultipleProps<TMultiple>, InfoProps, PlaceholderProps<TContext>, Pick<AFileUploadProps, 'mode' | 'showUploadButton'>, Omit<AFileUploadProps, 'name' | 'disabled' | 'multiple' | 'style' | 'class' | 'url' | 'accept' | 'maxFileSize' | 'fileLimit' | 'mode' | 'showUploadButton'> {
    /**
     * **This replaces the original PrimeVue `url` prop.** Remote url to upload
     * the files. Supports dynamic text props.
     *
     * @replaces url
     */
    url?: DProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * **This replaces the original PrimeVue `accept` prop.** Pattern to restrict
     * the allowed file types such as `'image/*'`. Supports dynamic text props.
     *
     * @replaces accept
     */
    accept?: DProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * **This replaces the original PrimeVue `maxFileSize` prop.** Maximum file
     * size allowed in bytes. Supports dynamic text props.
     *
     * @replaces maxFileSize
     */
    maxFileSize?: DProp<number, TContext>;
    /**
     * **This replaces the original PrimeVue `fileLimit` prop.** Maximum number of
     * files that can be uploaded. Supports dynamic text props.
     *
     * @replaces fileLimit
     */
    fileLimit?: DProp<number, TContext>;
}

}

/**
 * Factory API produced by the element blueprint's `blueprint` function,
 * optionally parameterized by concrete props. Prefer this over
 * `ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>` at consumer sites.
 */
export type LayoutApi<TProps extends LayoutProps = LayoutProps> = ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>;
/**
 * PrimeVue element layout blueprint. Extends the core element blueprint with
 * float/ifta-aware label tag logic — when a floating or IFTA label is active
 * the regular label renders as a `<span>` instead of a `<label>`.
 *
 * SFCs consume it via the shared composable: `useBlueprint(blueprint, props,
 * events, slots, extension?)`.
 *
 * @param props Resolved component props.
 * @param events Event emitter created by `defineEvents`.
 */
export declare function blueprint<TProps extends LayoutProps>(props: LooseRequired<TProps>, events: DefineEvents<LayoutEmits>): {
    useLabelTag: Readonly<import('vue').Ref<boolean, boolean>>;
    tags: {
        [x: string]: string | (() => string);
    };
    elementSlots: any;
    pager: Readonly<import('vue').Ref<any, any>>;
    infoTooltipArg: import('vue').ComputedRef<{
        position: any;
    }>;
    isLoading: import('vue').ComputedRef<boolean>;
    hasIcons: import('vue').ComputedRef<boolean>;
    hasLanguageAddon: import('vue').ComputedRef<any>;
    renderGroup: import('vue').ComputedRef<any>;
    hasFloat: import('vue').ComputedRef<boolean>;
    hasIfta: import('vue').ComputedRef<boolean>;
    hasLabelWrapper: import('vue').ComputedRef<boolean>;
    rootProps: import('vue').ComputedRef<any>;
    languageOptions: import('vue').ComputedRef<{
        code: string;
        label: unknown;
    }[]>;
    resolveAddonParts: (part: unknown, addon: any, i: number | string) => any;
    setLanguage: (val: string) => void;
    el$: any;
    parts: any;
    outlets: import('vue').ComputedRef<{
        template: any;
    }>;
    tokens: import('vue').ComputedRef<import('vue').CSSProperties>;
    tokenClass: string;
    tokenCss: import('vue').ComputedRef<string>;
    nonce: Readonly<import('vue').Ref<string | undefined, string | undefined>>;
    isContainer: Readonly<import('vue').Ref<boolean, boolean>>;

/**
 * Plain props type for the listbox element blueprint — the widest instantiation
 * of `ListboxProps`. Use this whenever "the props of a listbox" is meant
 * without generic narrowing; it also serves as the constraint for `blueprint` /
 * `ListboxApi` type parameters.
 */
type LooseListboxProps = ListboxProps<string, OptionsProp, OptionValueProp, OptionGroupChildrenProp, boolean>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the listbox element blueprint, parameterized by
 * the option-driving type arguments. Reach for `LooseListboxProps` instead when
 * no narrowing is needed.
 */
export interface ListboxProps<T extends string = 'listbox', TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends OptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown, S = ListboxSlots, P = ListboxParts, C = ListboxClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<OptionsModelProp<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, LoadingProps<TContext>, MultipleProps<TMultiple>, InfoProps, OptionsProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TOptionValueReturn, TContext>, Omit<AListboxProps, 'modelValue' | 'defaultValue' | 'name' | 'invalid' | 'fluid' | 'formControl' | 'disabled' | 'multiple' | 'options' | 'optionLabel' | 'optionValue' | 'optionDisabled' | 'optionGroupLabel' | 'optionGroupChildren'> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the listbox element.

export interface ListboxEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseElementEmits<TContext>, ModelEmits<any, TContext>, InteractionEmits<TContext>, ValidationEmits<TContext>, InputEmits<ListboxChangeEvent['value'], TContext>, ForwardedEmits<AListboxEmits, (typeof forwards.events)[number], TContext> {
}
/**

export interface ListboxSlots<TContext = any> extends BaseElementSlots<TContext> {

/**
 * Factory API produced by the listbox blueprint's `blueprint` function,
 * optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * `ListboxApi<VfListboxProps<typeof options, 'id'>>`). Prefer this over
 * `ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>` at consumer sites (Expose / Context
 * layers, extensions).
 */
export type ListboxApi<TProps extends LooseListboxProps = LooseListboxProps> = OptionsModelApi<ReturnType<typeof blueprint>, TProps>;
/**
 * PrimeVue Listbox events and slots to forward from the Vueform adapter to the
 * underlying PrimeVue component.
 */
export declare const forwards: {
    readonly events: readonly ["value-change", "filter", "option-dblclick", "item-dblclick"];
    readonly slots: readonly ["header", "footer", "option", "optiongroup", "emptyfilter", "empty", "content", "loader", "filtericon"];
};
/**
 * Builds the listbox factory API from resolved props and events.
 *
 * SFCs consume it via the shared composable: `useBlueprint(blueprint, props,
 * events, slots, extension?)`. Passing `blueprint` as a value lets call-site
 * inference instantiate the API at the SFC's concrete props — the only
 * alternative to a per-blueprint wrapper hosting `typeof blueprint<TProps>`,
 * since conditional-type inference on a captured factory erases its type

/**

 * instantiation of `MultiSelectProps`. Use this whenever "the props of a
 * multi-select" is meant without generic narrowing; it also serves as the
 * constraint for `blueprint` / `MultiSelectApi` type parameters.
 */
type LooseMultiSelectProps = MultiSelectProps<string, OptionsProp, OptionValueProp, OptionGroupChildrenProp>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the multi-select element blueprint, parameterized
 * by the option-driving type arguments. Reach for `LooseMultiSelectProps`
 * instead when no narrowing is needed. Selection is always multiple.
 */
export interface MultiSelectProps<T extends string = 'multi-select', TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends OptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown, S = MultiSelectSlots, P = MultiSelectParts, C = MultiSelectClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<OptionsModelProp<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, true, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AddonsProps<TContext>, IconsProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, LoadingProps<TContext>, PlaceholderProps<TContext>, FloatLabelProps, IftaLabelProps, InfoProps, OptionsProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TOptionValueReturn, TContext>, Omit<AMultiSelectProps, 'modelValue' | 'defaultValue' | 'name' | 'invalid' | 'fluid' | 'formControl' | 'disabled' | 'placeholder' | 'loading' | 'options' | 'optionLabel' | 'optionValue' | 'optionDisabled' | 'optionGroupLabel' | 'optionGroupChildren'> {
}

//// blueprints/radio-button.d.ts
import { BaseElementClasses, BaseElementEmits, BaseElementExpose, BaseElementParts, BaseElementProps, BaseElementSlots, DefineEvents, LooseRequired, AriaProps, ExpressionProps, AddonableProps, ValidationProps, DisabledProps, ReadonlyProps, LayoutProps, ModelEmits, InteractionEmits, InputEmits, ValidationEmits, TProp, AlignedProps, ModelApi } from '@vueform/core';
import { ForwardedEmits } from '../types';
import { RadioButtonProps as ARadioButtonProps, RadioButtonEmitsOptions as ARadioButtonEmits } from 'primevue/radiobutton';
import { ModelPropsWithDefaultValue, InfoProps } from '../features';
/**
 * Radio-button model shape: the `value` prop type, or `null` when unselected.
 */
type RadioButtonModelOf<TRadioValue> = TRadioValue | null;
/**
 * Model / default prop type for radio-button — `NoInfer` so `modelValue` does
 * not compete with `value` when inferring generics.
 */
type RadioButtonModelProp<TRadioValue> = NoInfer<RadioButtonModelOf<TRadioValue>>;
/**
 * The model value type carried by the radio-button element's wide props.
 */
type RadioButtonModel = Required<RadioButtonProps>['modelValue'];
/**
 * Props for the radio-button element blueprint, parameterized by the
 * model-driving type argument (`value`). Plain usage (`RadioButtonProps`) keeps
 * every member wide, so no separate plain-props alias is needed.
 */
export interface RadioButtonProps<T extends string = 'radio-button', TRadioValue = any, S = RadioButtonSlots, P = RadioButtonParts, C = RadioButtonClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<RadioButtonModelProp<TRadioValue>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, ReadonlyProps<TContext>, InfoProps, AlignedProps, Omit<ARadioButtonProps, 'modelValue' | 'defaultValue' | 'name' | 'invalid' | 'formControl' | 'disabled' | 'readonly' | 'binary' | 'value'> {
    /**
     * Overrides the HTML `name` attribute for the radio input.
     */
    radioName?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The label text displayed next to the radio button.
     */
    text?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * Positions the label text relative to the radio button (`left`, `right`, or
     * `auto`).
     */
    align?: 'left' | 'right' | 'auto';
    /**
     * The value submitted when this radio is selected. Also drives the model type
     * (as `value | null`). May be an object or array when the radios list is
     * built from complex item values.
     *
     * Includes a naked `boolean` arm alongside `TRadioValue` so the erased schema
     * surface (and blueprint defaults) still accept `true` / `false` literals.
     * Concrete values continue to infer into `TRadioValue`.
     */
    value?: TRadioValue | boolean;
}

 * Events emitted by the radio-button element.

}

/**
 * Plain props type for the select-button element blueprint — the widest
 * instantiation of `SelectButtonProps`. Use this whenever "the props of a
 * select-button" is meant without generic narrowing; it also serves as the
 * constraint for `blueprint` / `SelectButtonApi` type parameters.
 */
type LooseSelectButtonProps = SelectButtonProps<string, OptionsProp, OptionValueProp, boolean>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the select-button element blueprint,
 * parameterized by the option-driving type arguments. Reach for
 * `LooseSelectButtonProps` instead when no narrowing is needed. Groups are not
 * supported — `optionGroup*` props are omitted.
 */
export interface SelectButtonProps<T extends string = 'select-button', TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown, S = SelectButtonSlots, P = SelectButtonParts, C = SelectButtonClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<OptionsModelProp<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, undefined, TMultiple, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, LoadingProps<TContext>, MultipleProps<TMultiple>, InfoProps, Omit<OptionsProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, undefined, TOptionValueReturn, TContext>, 'optionGroupLabel' | 'optionGroupChildren' | 'optionGroupConditions'>, Omit<ASelectButtonProps, 'modelValue' | 'defaultValue' | 'name' | 'invalid' | 'fluid' | 'formControl' | 'disabled' | 'multiple' | 'options' | 'optionLabel' | 'optionValue' | 'optionDisabled'> {
}

/**

 * optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.

 * over `ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>` at consumer sites (Expose /

/**
 * Plain props type for the select element blueprint — the widest instantiation
 * of `SelectProps`. Use this whenever "the props of a select" is meant without
 * generic narrowing; it also serves as the constraint for `blueprint` /
 * `SelectApi` type parameters.
 */
type LooseSelectProps = SelectProps<string, OptionsProp, OptionValueProp, OptionGroupChildrenProp, boolean>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the select element blueprint, parameterized by
 * the option-driving type arguments. Reach for `LooseSelectProps` instead when
 * no narrowing is needed.
 */
export interface SelectProps<T extends string = 'select', TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends OptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown, S = SelectSlots, P = SelectParts, C = SelectClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<OptionsModelProp<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AddonsProps<TContext>, IconsProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, LoadingProps<TContext>, PlaceholderProps<TContext>, FloatLabelProps, IftaLabelProps, InfoProps, OptionsProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TOptionValueReturn, TContext>, MultipleProps<TMultiple>, Omit<ASelectProps, 'modelValue' | 'defaultValue' | 'name' | 'invalid' | 'fluid' | 'formControl' | 'disabled' | 'placeholder' | 'loading' | 'options' | 'optionLabel' | 'optionValue' | 'optionDisabled' | 'optionGroupLabel' | 'optionGroupChildren'> {
}

 * Factory API produced by the select blueprint's `blueprint` function,
 * optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * `SelectApi<VfSelectProps<typeof options, 'id'>>`). Prefer this over
 * `ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>` at consumer sites (Expose / Context
 * layers, extensions).
 */
export type SelectApi<TProps extends LooseSelectProps = LooseSelectProps> = OptionsModelApi<ReturnType<typeof blueprint>, TProps>;
/**
 * PrimeVue Select events and slots to forward from the Vueform adapter to the
 * underlying PrimeVue component.
 */
export declare const forwards: {
    readonly events: readonly ["value-change", "before-show", "before-hide", "show", "hide", "filter"];
    readonly slots: readonly ["value", "header", "footer", "option", "optiongroup", "emptyfilter", "empty", "content", "loader", "clearicon", "dropdownicon", "loadingicon", "filtericon"];
};
/**
 * Builds the select factory API from resolved props and events.
 *
 * SFCs consume it via the shared composable: `useBlueprint(blueprint, props,
 * events, slots, extension?)`. Passing `blueprint` as a value lets call-site
 * inference instantiate the API at the SFC's concrete props — the only
 * alternative to a per-blueprint wrapper hosting `typeof blueprint<TProps>`,
 * since conditional-type inference on a captured factory erases its type

//// blueprints/slider.d.ts
import { BaseElementClasses, BaseElementEmits, BaseElementExpose, BaseElementParts, BaseElementProps, BaseElementSlots, DefineEvents, LooseRequired, AriaProps, ExpressionProps, ValidationProps, DisabledProps, LayoutProps, ModelEmits, InteractionEmits, InputEmits, ValidationEmits, AddonableProps, TextishArrayModel, TextishMaybeArrayModel, TextishModel, ModelApi } from '@vueform/core';
import { ForwardedEmits } from '../types';
import { SliderProps as ASliderProps, SliderEmitsOptions as ASliderEmits } from 'primevue/slider';
import { ModelPropsWithDefaultValue, InfoProps, IntervalProps } from '../features';
/**
 * Slider model shaped by `range`:
 *
 * - `range: false` — `string | number | null`
 * - `range: true` — `(string | number)[]`
 * - `range` unset / wide `boolean` — `TextishMaybeArrayModel`
 */
type SliderModelOf<TRange extends boolean = boolean> = [boolean] extends [
    TRange
] ? TextishMaybeArrayModel : [TRange] extends [true] ? TextishArrayModel : TextishModel;
/**
 * Model / default prop type for slider — `NoInfer` so `modelValue` does not
 * compete with `range` when inferring generics.
 */
type SliderModelProp<TRange extends boolean = boolean> = NoInfer<SliderModelOf<TRange>>;
/**
 * The model value type carried by the slider element's wide props.
 */
type SliderModel = Required<SliderProps>['modelValue'];
/**
 * Props for the slider element blueprint, parameterized by the model-driving
 * type argument (`range`). Plain usage (`SliderProps`) keeps every member wide,
 * so no separate plain-props alias is needed.
 *
 * - `range: false` — model is a scalar
 * - `range: true` — model is an array of two boundary values
 */
export interface SliderProps<T extends string = 'slider', TRange extends boolean = boolean, S = SliderSlots, P = SliderParts, C = SliderClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<SliderModelProp<TRange>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, InfoProps, IntervalProps, Omit<ASliderProps, 'modelValue' | 'defaultValue' | 'name' | 'invalid' | 'formControl' | 'disabled' | 'min' | 'max' | 'step' | 'range'> {
    /**
     * When specified, allows two boundary values to be picked. Includes a naked
     * `boolean` arm alongside `TRange` so the erased schema surface still accepts
     * `range: true`. Literals continue to infer into `TRange`.
     */
    range?: TRange | boolean;
}

 * Events emitted by the slider element.

}

//// blueprints/toggle-switch.d.ts
import { BaseElementClasses, BaseElementEmits, BaseElementExpose, BaseElementParts, BaseElementProps, BaseElementSlots, DefineEvents, LooseRequired, AriaProps, ExpressionProps, ValidationProps, DisabledProps, ReadonlyProps, LayoutProps, ModelEmits, InteractionEmits, InputEmits, ValidationEmits, AddonableProps, AlignedProps, ModelApi, DProp } from '@vueform/core';
import { ForwardedEmits } from '../types';
import { ToggleSwitchProps as AToggleSwitchProps, ToggleSwitchEmitsOptions as AToggleSwitchEmits } from 'primevue/toggleswitch';
import { ModelPropsWithDefaultValue, InfoProps } from '../features';
/**
 * Toggle-switch model shape: the union of `trueValue` and `falseValue`.
 */
type ToggleSwitchModelOf<TTrueValue, TFalseValue> = TTrueValue | TFalseValue;
/**
 * Model / default prop type for toggle-switch — `NoInfer` so `modelValue` does
 * not compete with `trueValue` / `falseValue` when inferring generics.
 */
type ToggleSwitchModelProp<TTrueValue, TFalseValue> = NoInfer<ToggleSwitchModelOf<TTrueValue, TFalseValue>>;
/**
 * The model value type carried by the toggle-switch element's wide props.
 */
type ToggleSwitchModel = Required<ToggleSwitchProps>['modelValue'];
/**
 * Props for the toggle-switch element blueprint, parameterized by the
 * model-driving type arguments (`trueValue` / `falseValue`). Plain usage
 * (`ToggleSwitchProps`) keeps every member wide, so no separate plain-props
 * alias is needed.
 */
export interface ToggleSwitchProps<T extends string = 'toggle-switch', TTrueValue = any, TFalseValue = any, S = ToggleSwitchSlots, P = ToggleSwitchParts, C = ToggleSwitchClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<ToggleSwitchModelProp<TTrueValue, TFalseValue>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, ReadonlyProps<TContext>, InfoProps, AlignedProps, Omit<AToggleSwitchProps, 'modelValue' | 'defaultValue' | 'name' | 'invalid' | 'formControl' | 'disabled' | 'readonly' | 'trueValue' | 'falseValue'> {
    /**
     * The value used when the switch is on. Also drives one arm of the model
     * type.
     *
     * Includes a naked `boolean` arm alongside `TTrueValue` so the erased schema
     * surface (and blueprint defaults) still accept `true` / `false` literals.
     * Concrete values continue to infer into `TTrueValue`.
     */
    trueValue?: TTrueValue | boolean;
    /**
     * The value used when the switch is off. Also drives one arm of the model
     * type.
     *
     * Includes a naked `boolean` arm alongside `TFalseValue` so the erased schema
     * surface (and blueprint defaults) still accept `true` / `false` literals.
     * Concrete values continue to infer into `TFalseValue`.
     */
    falseValue?: TFalseValue | boolean;
    /**
     * Icon displayed when the switch is in the on state.
     */
    onIcon?: DProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * Icon displayed when the switch is in the off state.
     */
    offIcon?: DProp<string, TContext>;
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the toggle-switch element.
 */
export interface ToggleSwitchEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseElementEmits<TContext>, ModelEmits<ToggleSwitchModel, TContext>, InteractionEmits<TContext>, ValidationEmits<TContext>, InputEmits<ToggleSwitchModel, TContext>, ForwardedEmits<AToggleSwitchEmits, (typeof forwards.events)[number], TContext> {
}

 * Slots available in the toggle-switch element blueprint.
 */
export interface ToggleSwitchSlots<TContext = any> extends BaseElementSlots<TContext> {
}
/**

export interface ToggleSwitchParts extends BaseElementParts {
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the toggle-switch element blueprint.
 */
export interface ToggleSwitchClasses extends BaseElementClasses {
}
/**

}

/**
 * Generic props interface for the tree-select element blueprint, parameterized
 * by the tree-option / selection-mode type arguments. Reach for
 * `LooseTreeSelectProps` instead when no narrowing is needed.
 */
export interface TreeSelectProps<T extends string = 'tree-select', TOptions extends TreeOptionsProp = TreeOptionsProp, TSelectionMode extends TreeSelectionModeProp = undefined, TModel = any, S = TreeSelectSlots, P = TreeSelectParts, C = TreeSelectClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<TreeSelectModelProp<TOptions, TSelectionMode, TModel>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AddonsProps<TContext>, IconsProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, LoadingProps<TContext>, PlaceholderProps<TContext>, FloatLabelProps, IftaLabelProps, InfoProps, TreeOptionsProps<TOptions>, Omit<ATreeSelectProps, 'modelValue' | 'defaultValue' | 'name' | 'invalid' | 'fluid' | 'formControl' | 'disabled' | 'placeholder' | 'loading' | 'options' | 'selectionMode'> {
    /**
     * Defines the selection mode. Controls the model value shape:
     *
     * - unset / `'single'` / `'multiple'` → `{ [key]?: true }`
     * - `'checkbox'` → `{ [key]?: { checked; partialChecked } }`
     */
    selectionMode?: TSelectionMode | 'single' | 'multiple' | 'checkbox';
}

    interface VfAddonProps extends PartProps<VfAddonParts, VfAddonContext>, ClassProps<VfAddonClasses, VfAddonContext>, ReclassProps<VfAddonClasses, VfAddonContext> {
    }
}

//// components/VfAddon/styled.d.ts
import { default as Component } from './unstyled';
import './styles';
export * from './unstyled';
export default Component;

//// components/VfAddon/styles.d.ts
import '@vueform/primevue/addon.css';

//// components/VfAddon/types.d.ts
import { AddonApi, AddonProps, AddonEmits, AddonParts, AddonSlots, AddonClasses, AddonExpose } from '../../blueprints/addon';
import { ClassValue, DefineElementContext, DefineRegistryEntry, DomAttrsOf } from '@vueform/core';
import { VNode } from 'vue';
/**
 * Props for the VfAddon component.
 *
 * The `part:*` / `class:*` / `reclass:*` shorthand attrs are injected into dist
 * by `@vueform/utils` (see the `#shorthands` marker import on `unstyled.ts`).
 */
export interface VfAddonProps extends AddonProps<VfAddonSlots, VfAddonParts, VfAddonClasses, VfAddonContext> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfAddon component.
 */
export interface VfAddonEmits extends AddonEmits<VfAddonContext> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfAddon component.
 */
export interface VfAddonSlots extends AddonSlots<VfAddonContext> {
    /**
     * Default slot for addon content.
     */
    default: () => VNode[];
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfAddon component.
 */
export interface VfAddonParts extends AddonParts {
    /**
     * The root wrapper element.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    root: DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfAddon component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfAddonClasses extends AddonClasses {
    /**
     * The root wrapper element.
     */
    root: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfAddon.
 *
 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `AddonExpose` for all addon-based components) so they
 * appear on `ContextOf<'VfAddon'>` / `context$` / `defineExpose`.
 */
export interface VfAddonExpose extends AddonExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfAddon.
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 *
 * Non-generic: no `TProps` parameter — the api has nothing to narrow from
 * props, so the context is a fixed `DefineElementContext` instantiation.
 */
export interface VfAddonContext extends DefineElementContext<VfAddonProps, VfAddonEmits, VfAddonSlots, VfAddonParts, VfAddonClasses, VfAddonExpose, AddonApi> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfAddon. `TEntry` is accepted for registry uniformity but
 * does not narrow anything — VfAddon has no prop-driven generics.
 */
export interface VfAddonEntry<_TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<VfAddonProps, VfAddonEmits, VfAddonSlots, VfAddonParts, VfAddonClasses, VfAddonContext> {
}

//// components/VfAddon/unstyled.d.ts
import { default as VfAddon, VfAddonEntry } from './index';
import './shorthands';
export * from './index';
export { default } from './index';
declare module '@vueform/core' {
    interface ComponentRegistry<TEntry> {
        VfAddon: VfAddonEntry<TEntry>;
    }
}
declare module 'vue' {
    interface GlobalComponents {
        VfAddon: typeof VfAddon;
    }
}

     */
    default: (props: {
        model: TTrueValue | TFalseValue;
        trueValue: TTrueValue;
        falseValue: TFalseValue;
        inputName: string;
        id: string;
        disabled: boolean;
        input: any;
        text: string | undefined;
        aria: AriaProp;
        handleBlur: (e: FocusEvent) => void;
        handleFocus: (e: FocusEvent) => void;
        handleInput: (payload: any, e?: Event) => void;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the text/label portion of the checkbox.
     *
     * @param props.text The resolved label text.
     * @param props.id The element's unique ID.
     * @param props.genericName The element's display name for accessibility.
     */
    text: (props: {
        text: string | undefined;
        id: string;
        genericName: string;
    }) => VNode[];
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfCheckbox component.
 */
export interface VfCheckboxParts extends CheckboxParts {
    /**
     * The wrapper element surrounding the input and text.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    wrapper: Record<string, any>;
    /**
     * The PrimeVue Checkbox input element.
     *
     * @tag Checkbox
     */
    input: PvCheckboxProps;
    /**
     * The label/text element.
     *
     * @tag label
     */
    text: Record<string, any>;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfCheckbox component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfCheckboxClasses extends CheckboxClasses {
    /**
     * The wrapper element surrounding the input and text.
     */
    wrapper: ClassValue;
    /**
     * The PrimeVue Checkbox input element.
     */
    input: ClassValue;
    /**
     * The label/text element.
     */
    text: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfCheckbox.
 *
 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `CheckboxExpose` for all checkbox-based components) so
 * they appear on `ContextOf<'VfCheckbox'>` / `context$` / `defineExpose`.
 */
export interface VfCheckboxExpose extends CheckboxExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfCheckbox, optionally parameterized by concrete props
 * (e.g. `VfCheckboxContext<VfCheckboxProps<1, 0>>`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 */
export interface VfCheckboxContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfCheckboxProps, CheckboxProps> = VfCheckboxProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfCheckboxEmits, VfCheckboxSlots, VfCheckboxParts, VfCheckboxClasses, VfCheckboxExpose, CheckboxApi<TProps>> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfCheckbox. `TEntry` narrows the props / emits / context
 * by the entry's model-driving props, the same way SFC generics do.
 */
export interface VfCheckboxEntry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<EntryProps<TEntry>, VfCheckboxEmits<EntryPropOr<TEntry, 'trueValue', true>, EntryPropOr<TEntry, 'falseValue', false>>, VfCheckboxSlots, VfCheckboxParts, VfCheckboxClasses, VfCheckboxContext<EntryProps<TEntry>>> {
}

 * option-driving type arguments so event handlers (e.g. `@change`) receive the

 */
export interface VfCheckboxGroupEmits<TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends OptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown> extends CheckboxGroupEmits<VfCheckboxGroupContext<VfCheckboxGroupProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>>> {

/**
 * Slots available in the VfCheckboxGroup component.
 */
export interface VfCheckboxGroupSlots<TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends OptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown> extends CheckboxGroupSlots<VfCheckboxGroupContext<VfCheckboxGroupProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>>> {
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the default checkboxes rendering.
     *
     * @param props.checkboxName The shared checkbox name attribute.
     * @param props.disabled Whether the checkboxes are disabled.
     * @param props.label The element's resolved label.
     * @param props.items Resolved flat checkbox items.
     * @param props.groups Resolved checkbox groups.
     * @param props.grouped Whether items are rendered as groups.
     */
    default: (props: {
        checkboxName: string;
        disabled: boolean;
        label: string | undefined;
        items: ResolvedOption<OptionValueOf<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TOptionValueReturn>, RawOptionOf<TOptions, TGroupChildren>>[];
        groups: ResolvedGroup<OptionValueOf<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TOptionValueReturn>, RawOptionOf<TOptions, TGroupChildren>>[];
        grouped: boolean;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each option group when items are grouped.
     *
     * @param props.checkboxName The shared checkbox name attribute.
     * @param props.disabled Whether the checkboxes are disabled.
     * @param props.label The element's resolved label.
     * @param props.group The resolved option group.
     */
    group: (props: {
        checkboxName: string;
        disabled: boolean;
        label: string | undefined;
        group: ResolvedGroup<OptionValueOf<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TOptionValueReturn>, RawOptionOf<TOptions, TGroupChildren>>;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each entire `VfCheckbox` child.
     *
     * @param props.checkboxName The shared checkbox name attribute.
     * @param props.disabled Whether the checkboxes are disabled.
     * @param props.label The element's resolved label.
     * @param props.item The resolved checkbox item.
     */
    item: (props: {
        checkboxName: string;
        disabled: boolean;
        label: string | undefined;
        item: ResolvedOption<OptionValueOf<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TOptionValueReturn>, RawOptionOf<TOptions, TGroupChildren>>;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each individual checkbox input rendering.
     *
     * Child checkboxes always use the default `true` / `false` values; the
     * holder's item value is resolved by name, not passed as `trueValue`.
     *
     * @inherits VfCheckbox.default
     */
    checkbox: (props: Parameters<VfCheckboxSlots['default']>[0]) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the text/label of each individual checkbox.
     *
     * @inherits VfCheckbox.text
     */
    text: (props: Parameters<VfCheckboxSlots['text']>[0]) => VNode[];
}

export interface VfCheckboxGroupParts extends CheckboxGroupParts {

    fieldset: (group: Record<string, any>) => DomAttrsOf<'fieldset'>;
    /**

     *
     * @param item The checkbox item data.
     * @tag VfCheckbox
     */
    item: (item: Record<string, any>) => PartOf<'VfCheckbox'>;
}

 * `selectionMode` prop, defaulting to `undefined` when absent or invalid.

export type EntrySelectionModeOf<TEntry> = EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'selectionMode'> extends infer M ? M extends DatePickerSelectionModeProp ? M : undefined : undefined;
/**
 * VfDatePicker props narrowed from a registry `TEntry` payload, applying the
 * entry's `selectionMode` prop as a generic.
 */
export type EntryProps<TEntry> = VfDatePickerProps<EntrySelectionModeOf<TEntry>>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the VfDatePicker component, parameterized by the
 * model-driving type argument (e.g. `VfDatePickerProps<'multiple'>`). Reach for
 * `VfDatePickerProps` instead when no narrowing is needed.
 *
 * The `part:*` / `class:*` / `reclass:*` shorthand attrs are injected into dist
 * by `@vueform/utils` (see the `#shorthands` marker import on `unstyled.ts`).
 */
export interface VfDatePickerProps<TSelectionMode extends DatePickerSelectionModeProp = DatePickerSelectionModeProp> extends DatePickerProps<'date-picker', TSelectionMode, VfDatePickerSlots<TSelectionMode>, VfDatePickerParts, VfDatePickerClasses, VfDatePickerContext<VfDatePickerProps<TSelectionMode>>> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfDatePicker component, parameterized by the
 * model-driving type argument so event handlers (e.g. `@change`) receive the
 * narrowed context — same pattern as `VfDatePickerSlots`. Plain usage
 * (`VfDatePickerEmits`) keeps the context wide.
 */
export interface VfDatePickerEmits<TSelectionMode extends DatePickerSelectionModeProp = DatePickerSelectionModeProp> extends DatePickerEmits<VfDatePickerContext<VfDatePickerProps<TSelectionMode>>> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfDatePicker component.
 */
export interface VfDatePickerSlots<TSelectionMode extends DatePickerSelectionModeProp = DatePickerSelectionModeProp> extends DatePickerSlots<VfDatePickerContext<VfDatePickerProps<TSelectionMode>>>, FloatLabelSlots, IftaSlots, AddonsSlots, IconsSlots, ForwardedSlots<ADatePickerSlots, (typeof forwards.slots)[number]> {
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfDatePicker component.
 */
export interface VfDatePickerParts extends DatePickerParts, AddonsParts, AddonGroupParts, IconsParts, FloatLabelParts, IftaParts {
    /**
     * The date picker input element.
     *
     * @tag DatePicker
     */
    input: PvDatePickerProps;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfDatePicker component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfDatePickerClasses extends DatePickerClasses, FloatLabelClasses, IftaClasses {
    /**
     * The date picker input element.
     */
    input: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfDatePicker.
 *
 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `DatePickerExpose` for all date-picker-based components)
 * so they appear on `ContextOf<'VfDatePicker'>` / `context$` / `defineExpose`.
 */
export interface VfDatePickerExpose extends DatePickerExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfDatePicker, optionally parameterized by concrete props
 * (e.g. `VfDatePickerContext<VfDatePickerProps<'multiple'>>`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 */
export interface VfDatePickerContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfDatePickerProps, DatePickerProps> = VfDatePickerProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfDatePickerEmits, VfDatePickerSlots, VfDatePickerParts, VfDatePickerClasses, VfDatePickerExpose, DatePickerApi<TProps>> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfDatePicker. `TEntry` narrows the props / emits / context
 * by the entry's model-driving props, the same way SFC generics do.
 */
export interface VfDatePickerEntry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<EntryProps<TEntry>, VfDatePickerEmits<EntrySelectionModeOf<TEntry>>, VfDatePickerSlots, VfDatePickerParts, VfDatePickerClasses, VfDatePickerContext<EntryProps<TEntry>>> {
}

import './shorthands';
export * from './index';
export { default } from './index';
declare module '@vueform/core' {
    interface ControlRegistry<TEntry> {
        VfDatePicker: VfDatePickerEntry<TEntry>;
    }
}
declare module 'vue' {
    interface GlobalComponents {
        VfDatePicker: typeof VfDatePicker;
    }
}

import { EditorProps as PvEditorProps, EditorSlots as AEditorSlots } from 'primevue/editor';
import { EditorApi, EditorClasses, EditorEmits, EditorExpose, EditorParts, EditorProps, EditorSlots, forwards } from '../../blueprints/editor';
import { ForwardedSlots } from '../../types';
import { ClassValue, EntryTranslateOf, EntryLanguagesOf, WidenProps, DefineElementContext, DefineRegistryEntry, LanguagesProp } from '@vueform/core';
import { VNode } from 'vue';
/**
 * VfEditor props narrowed from a registry `TEntry` payload, applying the
 * entry's `translate` / `languages` props as generics (so `translate: true`
 * forces a locale-keyed `modelValue`).
 */
export type EntryProps<TEntry> = VfEditorProps<EntryTranslateOf<TEntry>, EntryLanguagesOf<TEntry>>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the VfEditor component, parameterized by the
 * model-driving type arguments (e.g. `VfEditorProps<true, typeof languages>`).
 * Reach for `VfEditorProps` instead when no narrowing is needed.
 *
 * The `part:*` / `class:*` / `reclass:*` shorthand attrs are injected into dist
 * by `@vueform/utils` (see the `#shorthands` marker import on `unstyled.ts`).
 */
export interface VfEditorProps<TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp> extends EditorProps<'editor', TTranslate, TLanguages, VfEditorSlots<TTranslate, TLanguages>, VfEditorParts, VfEditorClasses, VfEditorContext<VfEditorProps<TTranslate, TLanguages>>> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfEditor component, parameterized by the model-driving
 * type arguments so event handlers (e.g. `@change`) receive the narrowed
 * context — same pattern as `VfEditorSlots`. Plain usage (`VfEditorEmits`)
 * keeps the context wide.
 */
export interface VfEditorEmits<TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp> extends EditorEmits<VfEditorContext<VfEditorProps<TTranslate, TLanguages>>> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfEditor component.
 */
export interface VfEditorSlots<TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp> extends EditorSlots<VfEditorContext<VfEditorProps<TTranslate, TLanguages>>>, ForwardedSlots<AEditorSlots, (typeof forwards.slots)[number]> {
    /**
     * Custom editor toolbar content.
     *
     * @param props.languages Available language labels keyed by locale code.
     * @param props.language The currently active language code.
     */
    toolbar: (props: {
        languages: Record<string, string>;
        language: string;
    }) => VNode[];
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfEditor component.
 */
export interface VfEditorParts extends EditorParts {
    /**
     * The editor element.
     *
     * @tag Editor
     */
    input: PvEditorProps;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfEditor component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfEditorClasses extends EditorClasses {
    /**
     * The editor element.
     */
    input: ClassValue;

/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfEditor.

 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `EditorExpose` for all editor-based components) so they
 * appear on `ContextOf<'VfEditor'>` / `context$` / `defineExpose`.
 */
export interface VfEditorExpose extends EditorExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfEditor, optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * `VfEditorContext<VfEditorProps<true, typeof languages>>`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 */
export interface VfEditorContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfEditorProps, EditorProps> = VfEditorProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfEditorEmits, VfEditorSlots, VfEditorParts, VfEditorClasses, VfEditorExpose, EditorApi<TProps>> {
}
/**

 * the entry's model-driving props, the same way SFC generics do.

export interface VfEditorEntry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<EntryProps<TEntry>, VfEditorEmits<EntryTranslateOf<TEntry>, EntryLanguagesOf<TEntry>>, VfEditorSlots, VfEditorParts, VfEditorClasses, VfEditorContext<EntryProps<TEntry>>> {
}

/**
 * Events emitted by the VfForm component, parameterized by the schema type so
 * event handlers (e.g. `@submit`) receive the schema-narrowed context — same

 * wide.
 */
export interface VfFormEmits<TSchema = FormSchema> extends FormEmits<VfFormContext<VfFormProps<TSchema>>> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfForm component, parameterized by the schema type so
 * context-receiving slots (e.g. `#content`) get the schema-narrowed context.
 * Plain usage (`VfFormSlots`) keeps the context wide.
 */
export interface VfFormSlots<TSchema = FormSchema> extends FormSlots<VfFormContext<VfFormProps<TSchema>>> {
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the entire form content area.
     *
     * @exposes VfForm
     */
    content: (props: {
        context: VfFormContext<VfFormProps<TSchema>>;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the form-level errors <ul> container.
     */
    errors: (props: {
        errors: Record<string, string[]>;
        id: string;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each individual error message inside <li>.
     */
    error: (props: {
        error: string;
        path: string;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the form-level messages <ul> container.
     */
    messages: (props: {
        messages?: string[];
        id: string;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each individual message inside <li>.
     */
    message: (props: {
        message: string;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the language navigation bar. Receives the available
     * languages and the current selection.
     */
    languages: (props: {
        languages: ResolvedLanguagesProp;
        language: string;
        invalidLanguages: Set<string>;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the tabs navigation bar. Receives the pager instance.
     */
    tabs: (props: {
        pager: Pager;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each individual tab.
     */
    tab: (props: {
        page: ResolvedPage;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the steps navigation bar. Receives the pager instance.
     */
    steps: (props: {
        pager: Pager;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * @write
     */
    step: (props: {
        page: ResolvedPage;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the form elements area. Receives the resolved schema.
     */
    elements: (props: {
        resolvedSchema: ResolvedSchema;
        pager?: Pager;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the navigation bar. Receives pager, button labels, and
     * visibility.
     */
    nav: (props: {
        pager: Pager;
        nextLabel?: TProp;
        backLabel?: TProp;
        finishLabel?: TProp;
        showBack: boolean;
        position?: NavPosProp;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the back button in the navigation bar.
     *
     * @inherits VfNav.back
     */
    back: (props: SlotPropsOf<'VfNav', 'back'>) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the back button's text label.
     *
     * @inherits VfNav.backText
     */
    backText: (props: SlotPropsOf<'VfNav', 'backText'>) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the next button in the navigation bar.
     *
     * @inherits VfNav.next
     */
    next: (props: SlotPropsOf<'VfNav', 'next'>) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the next button's text label.
     *
     * @inherits VfNav.nextText
     */
    nextText: (props: SlotPropsOf<'VfNav', 'nextText'>) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the finish button in the navigation bar.
     *
     * @inherits VfNav.finish
     */
    finish: (props: SlotPropsOf<'VfNav', 'finish'>) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the finish button's text label.
     *
     * @inherits VfNav.finishText
     */
    finishText: (props: SlotPropsOf<'VfNav', 'finishText'>) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot for the default form body content. Receives the resolved schema.
     */
    default: (props: {
        resolvedSchema: ResolvedSchema;
    }) => VNode[];
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfForm component.
 */
export interface VfFormParts extends FormParts {
    /**
     * The root form element.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    root: DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * Props forwarded to the nested TabList component.
     *
     * @tag TabList
     */
    tabsContainer: TabListProps;
    /**
     * @write
     */
    stepsContainer: StepperProps;
    /**
     * The errors container element.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    errorsWrapper: DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * The error list element.
     *
     * @tag ul
     */
    errors: DomAttrsOf<'ul'>;
    /**
     * Each error item element.
     *
     * @tag li
     */
    error: DomAttrsOf<'li'>;
    /**
     * The messages container element.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    messagesWrapper: DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * The message list element.
     *
     * @tag ul
     */
    messages: DomAttrsOf<'ul'>;
    /**
     * Each message item element.
     *
     * @tag li
     */
    message: DomAttrsOf<'li'>;
    /**
     * Props forwarded to the nested TabList component.
     *
     * @tag VfSelectButton
     */
    languages: PartOf<'VfSelectButton'>;
    /**
     * @write
     */
    tabs: TabListProps;
    /**
     * @write
     *
     * @tag Tab
     */
    tab: (page: ResolvedPage) => TabProps;
    /**
     * Props forwarded to the nested VfSteps component.
     *
     * @tag StepList
     */
    steps: StepListProps;
    /**
     * @write
     */
    step: (page: ResolvedPage) => StepProps;
    /**
     * @write
     */
    stepInner: (page: ResolvedPage) => DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * @write
     */
    stepHeader: (page: ResolvedPage) => DomAttrsOf<'button'>;
    /**
     * @write
     */
    stepNumber: (page: ResolvedPage) => DomAttrsOf<'span'>;
    /**
     * @write
     */
    stepIcon: (page: ResolvedPage) => DomAttrsOf<'i'>;
    /**
     * @write
     */
    stepTitle: (page: ResolvedPage) => DomAttrsOf<'span'>;
    /**
     * @write
     */
    stepItem: (page: ResolvedPage) => StepProps;
    /**
     * @write
     */
    stepPanel: (page: ResolvedPage) => StepProps;
    /**
     * Props forwarded to the nested VfNav component.
     *
     * @tag VfNav
     */
    nav: PartOf<'VfNav'>;
    /**
     * Props forwarded to the nested VfElements component.
     *
     * @tag VfElements
     */
    elements: PartOf<'VfElements'>;
    /**
     * @write
     */
    tabPanels: TabPanelsProps;
    /**
     * @write
     */
    stepPanels: StepPanelsProps;
}

/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfForm.
 *
 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `FormExpose` for all form-based components) so they
 * appear on `ContextOf<'VfForm'>` / `context$` / `defineExpose`.
 */
export interface VfFormExpose extends FormExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfForm, optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * `VfFormContext<VfFormProps<typeof schema>>`) so the schema API slice (`find`
 * / `get` / `set` / `model` / `payload` / `update`) narrows to the schema
 * carried by the `schema` prop.
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 */
export interface VfFormContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfFormProps, FormProps<FormSlots, FormParts, FormClasses, any, any>> = VfFormProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfFormEmits, VfFormSlots, VfFormParts, VfFormClasses, VfFormExpose, FormApi<TProps>> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfForm. `TEntry` narrows the schema API slice of the
 * context by the entry's `schema` prop, the same way the SFC generic does.
 */
export interface VfFormEntry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<EntryProps<TEntry>, VfFormEmits<EntrySchemaOf<TEntry>>, VfFormSlots, VfFormParts, VfFormClasses, VfFormContext<EntryProps<TEntry>>> {
}

    interface ComponentRegistry<TEntry> {
        VfForm: VfFormEntry<TEntry>;
    }
}

        VfForm: typeof VfForm;
    }
}
