export interface VfInputTextProps<TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp> extends InputTextProps<'input-text', TTranslate, TLanguages, VfInputTextSlots<TTranslate, TLanguages>, VfInputTextParts, VfInputTextClasses, VfInputTextContext<VfInputTextProps<TTranslate, TLanguages>>> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfInputText component, parameterized by the
 * model-driving type arguments so event handlers (e.g. `@change`) receive the
 * narrowed context — same pattern as `VfInputTextSlots`. Plain usage
 * (`VfInputTextEmits`) keeps the context wide.
 */
export interface VfInputTextEmits<TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp> extends InputTextEmits<VfInputTextContext<VfInputTextProps<TTranslate, TLanguages>>> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfInputText component.
 */
export interface VfInputTextSlots<TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp> extends InputTextSlots<VfInputTextContext<VfInputTextProps<TTranslate, TLanguages>>>, FloatLabelSlots, IftaSlots, AddonsSlots, IconsSlots, TranslateSlots {
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfInputText component.
 */
export interface VfInputTextParts extends InputTextParts, AddonsParts, AddonGroupParts, IconsParts, TranslateParts, FloatLabelParts, IftaParts {
    /**
     * The text input element.
     *
     * @tag InputText
     */
    input: PvInputTextProps;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfInputText component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfInputTextClasses extends InputTextClasses, FloatLabelClasses, IftaClasses {
    /**
     * The text input element.
     */
    input: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfInputText.
 *
 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `InputTextExpose` for all input-text-based components) so
 * they appear on `ContextOf<'VfInputText'>` / `context$` / `defineExpose`.
 */
export interface VfInputTextExpose extends InputTextExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfInputText, optionally parameterized by concrete props
 * (e.g. `VfInputTextContext<VfInputTextProps<true, typeof languages>>`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 */
export interface VfInputTextContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfInputTextProps, InputTextProps> = VfInputTextProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfInputTextEmits, VfInputTextSlots, VfInputTextParts, VfInputTextClasses, VfInputTextExpose, InputTextApi<TProps>> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfInputText. `TEntry` narrows the props / emits / context
 * by the entry's model-driving props, the same way SFC generics do.
 */
export interface VfInputTextEntry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<EntryProps<TEntry>, VfInputTextEmits<EntryTranslateOf<TEntry>, EntryLanguagesOf<TEntry>>, VfInputTextSlots, VfInputTextParts, VfInputTextClasses, VfInputTextContext<EntryProps<TEntry>>> {
}

 * by `@vueform/utils` (see the `#shorthands` marker import on `unstyled.ts`).
 */
export interface VfListboxProps<TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends OptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown> extends ListboxProps<'listbox', TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TOptionValueReturn, VfListboxSlots<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>, VfListboxParts, VfListboxClasses, VfListboxContext<VfListboxProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>>> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfListbox component, parameterized by the
 * option-driving type arguments so event handlers (e.g. `@change`) receive the
 * narrowed context — same pattern as `VfListboxSlots`. Plain usage
 * (`VfListboxEmits`) keeps the context wide.
 */
export interface VfListboxEmits<TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends OptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown> extends ListboxEmits<VfListboxContext<VfListboxProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>>> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfListbox component.
 *
 * Forwarded PrimeVue slot shapes use wide item/model types.
 */
export interface VfListboxSlots<TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends OptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown> extends ListboxSlots<VfListboxContext<VfListboxProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>>>, OverrideSlots<ForwardedSlots<AListboxSlots, (typeof forwards.slots)[number]>, {
    /**
     * Custom header template.
     */
    header: (props: {
        /**
         * Value of the component.
         */
        value: any;
        /**
         * Displayed options.
         */
        options: any[];
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Custom footer template.
     */
    footer: (props: {
        /**
         * Value of the component.
         */
        value: any;
        /**
         * Displayed options.
         */
        options: any[];
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Custom option template.
     */
    option: (props: {
        /**
         * The raw option item.
         */
        option: any;
        /**
         * Selection state.
         */
        selected: boolean;
        /**
         * Index of the option.
         */
        index: number;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Custom option group template.
     */
    optiongroup: (props: {
        /**
         * The raw option group (or raw item when ungrouped).
         */
        option: any;
        /**
         * Index of the option group.
         */
        index: number;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Custom content template.
     */
    content: (props: {
        /**
         * An array of objects to display for virtualscroller.
         */
        items: any[];
        /**
         * Style class of the component.
         */
        styleClass: string;
        /**
         * Reference of the content.
         */
        contentRef: (el: any) => void;
        /**
         * Options of the items.
         */
        getItemOptions: (index: number) => VirtualScrollerItemOptions;
    }) => VNode[];
}> {
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfListbox component.
 */
export interface VfListboxParts extends ListboxParts {
    /**
     * The listbox input element.
     *
     * @tag Listbox
     */
    input: PvListboxProps;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfListbox component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfListboxClasses extends ListboxClasses {
    /**
     * The listbox input element.
     */
    input: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfListbox.
 *
 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `ListboxExpose` for all listbox-based components) so they
 * appear on `ContextOf<'VfListbox'>` / `context$` / `defineExpose`.
 */
export interface VfListboxExpose extends ListboxExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfListbox, optionally parameterized by concrete props
 * (e.g. `VfListboxContext<VfListboxProps<typeof options, 'id'>>`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 */
export interface VfListboxContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfListboxProps, ListboxProps<string, OptionsProp, OptionValueProp, OptionGroupChildrenProp>> = VfListboxProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfListboxEmits, VfListboxSlots, VfListboxParts, VfListboxClasses, VfListboxExpose, ListboxApi<TProps>> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfListbox. `TEntry` narrows the props / emits / context by
 * the entry's option-driving props, the same way SFC generics do.
 */
export interface VfListboxEntry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<EntryProps<TEntry>, VfListboxEmits<EntryOptionsOf<TEntry>, EntryOptionValueKeyOf<TEntry>, EntryOptionGroupChildrenOf<TEntry>, EntryMultipleOf<TEntry>, any, EntryOptionValueReturnOf<TEntry>>, VfListboxSlots, VfListboxParts, VfListboxClasses, VfListboxContext<EntryProps<TEntry>>> {
}

//// components/VfListbox/unstyled.d.ts
import { default as VfListbox, VfListboxEntry } from './index';
import './shorthands';
export * from './index';
export { default } from './index';
declare module '@vueform/core' {
    interface ControlRegistry<TEntry> {
        VfListbox: VfListboxEntry<TEntry>;
    }
}
declare module 'vue' {
    interface GlobalComponents {
        VfListbox: typeof VfListbox;
    }
}

 * by `@vueform/utils` (see the `#shorthands` marker import on `unstyled.ts`).
 */
export interface VfMultiSelectProps<TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends OptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown> extends MultiSelectProps<'multi-select', TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TOptionValueReturn, VfMultiSelectSlots<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>, VfMultiSelectParts, VfMultiSelectClasses, VfMultiSelectContext<VfMultiSelectProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>>> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfMultiSelect component, parameterized by the
 * option-driving type arguments so event handlers (e.g. `@change`) receive the
 * narrowed context — same pattern as `VfMultiSelectSlots`. Plain usage
 * (`VfMultiSelectEmits`) keeps the context wide.
 */
export interface VfMultiSelectEmits<TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends OptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown> extends MultiSelectEmits<VfMultiSelectContext<VfMultiSelectProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>>> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfMultiSelect component.
 *
 * `#template` is generic-aware; forwarded PrimeVue slot shapes use wide
 * item/model types.
 */
export interface VfMultiSelectSlots<TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends OptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown> extends MultiSelectSlots<VfMultiSelectContext<VfMultiSelectProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>>>, FloatLabelSlots, IftaSlots, AddonsSlots, IconsSlots, OverrideSlots<ForwardedSlots<AMultiSelectSlots, (typeof forwards.slots)[number]>, {
    /**
     * Custom selected value display.
     */
    value: (props: {
        /**
         * Selected values of the component.
         */
        value: any;
        /**
         * Placeholder prop value.
         */
        placeholder: string;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Custom chip template for a selected value.
     */
    chip: (props: {
        /**
         * A value in the selection.
         */
        value: any;
        /**
         * Removes the chip from the selection.
         *
         * @param event Browser event.
         * @param item Selected value to remove.
         */
        removeCallback: (event: Event, item: any) => void;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Custom chip remove icon template.
     */
    chipicon: (props: {
        /**
         * Style class of the icon.
         */
        class: string;
        /**
         * Selected value associated with the chip.
         */
        item: any;
        /**
         * Removes the chip from the selection.
         *
         * @param event Browser event.
         * @param item Selected value to remove.
         */
        removeCallback: (event: Event, item: any) => void;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Custom header template of the overlay panel.
     */
    header: (props: {
        /**
         * Selected values of the component.
         */
        value: any;
        /**
         * Displayed options.
         */
        options: any[];
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Custom footer template of the overlay panel.
     */
    footer: (props: {
        /**
         * Selected values of the component.
         */
        value: any;
        /**
         * Displayed options.
         */
        options: any[];
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Custom content for each option.
     */
    option: (props: {
        /**
         * The raw option item.
         */
        option: any;
        /**
         * Selection state.
         */
        selected: boolean;
        /**
         * Index of the option.
         */
        index: number;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Custom content for each option group.
     */
    optiongroup: (props: {
        /**
         * The option group, or raw item when groups are not used.
         */
        option: any;
        /**
         * Index of the option group.
         */
        index: number;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Custom content template for virtual scrolling.
     */
    content: (props: {
        /**
         * Items to display for the virtual scroller.
         */
        items: any[];
        /**
         * Style class of the content.
         */
        styleClass: string;
        /**
         * Sets the content element ref.
         *
         * @param el Content element.
         */
        contentRef: (el: any) => void;
        /**
         * Returns virtual scroller item options for a rendered index.
         *
         * @param index Rendered index.
         */
        getItemOptions: (index: number) => any;
    }) => VNode[];
}> {
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfMultiSelect component.
 */
export interface VfMultiSelectParts extends MultiSelectParts, AddonsParts, AddonGroupParts, IconsParts, FloatLabelParts, IftaParts {
    /**
     * The multi-select input element.
     *
     * @tag MultiSelect
     */
    input: PvMultiSelectProps;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfMultiSelect component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfMultiSelectClasses extends MultiSelectClasses, FloatLabelClasses, IftaClasses {
    /**
     * The multi-select input element.
     */
    input: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfMultiSelect.
 *
 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `MultiSelectExpose` for all multi-select-based
 * components) so they appear on `ContextOf<'VfMultiSelect'>` / `context$` /
 * `defineExpose`.
 */
export interface VfMultiSelectExpose extends MultiSelectExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfMultiSelect, optionally parameterized by concrete props
 * (e.g. `VfMultiSelectContext<VfMultiSelectProps<typeof options, 'id'>>`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 */
export interface VfMultiSelectContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfMultiSelectProps, MultiSelectProps<string, OptionsProp, OptionValueProp, OptionGroupChildrenProp>> = VfMultiSelectProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfMultiSelectEmits, VfMultiSelectSlots, VfMultiSelectParts, VfMultiSelectClasses, VfMultiSelectExpose, MultiSelectApi<TProps>> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfMultiSelect. `TEntry` narrows the props / emits /
 * context by the entry's option-driving props, the same way SFC generics do.
 */
export interface VfMultiSelectEntry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<EntryProps<TEntry>, VfMultiSelectEmits<EntryOptionsOf<TEntry>, EntryOptionValueKeyOf<TEntry>, EntryOptionGroupChildrenOf<TEntry>, any, EntryOptionValueReturnOf<TEntry>>, VfMultiSelectSlots, VfMultiSelectParts, VfMultiSelectClasses, VfMultiSelectContext<EntryProps<TEntry>>> {
}

import './shorthands';
export * from './index';
export { default } from './index';
declare module '@vueform/core' {
    interface ControlRegistry<TEntry> {
        VfMultiSelect: VfMultiSelectEntry<TEntry>;
    }
}
declare module 'vue' {
    interface GlobalComponents {
        VfMultiSelect: typeof VfMultiSelect;
    }
}

/**
 * Slots available in the VfRadioButtonGroup component.
 */
export interface VfRadioButtonGroupSlots<TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends OptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown, TValue = OptionValueOf<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TOptionValueReturn>, TRaw = RawOptionOf<TOptions, TGroupChildren>> extends RadioButtonGroupSlots<VfRadioButtonGroupContext<VfRadioButtonGroupProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>>> {

     * items, groups, and shared state.

    default: (props: {
        radioName: string;

export type EntryProps<TEntry> = VfSelectProps<EntryOptionsOf<TEntry>, EntryOptionValueKeyOf<TEntry>, EntryOptionGroupChildrenOf<TEntry>, EntryMultipleOf<TEntry>, any, EntryOptionValueReturnOf<TEntry>>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the VfSelect component, parameterized by the
 * option-driving type arguments (e.g. `VfSelectProps<typeof options, 'id'>`).
 * Reach for `VfSelectProps` instead when no narrowing is needed.
 *
 * The `part:*` / `class:*` / `reclass:*` shorthand attrs are injected into dist
 * by `@vueform/utils` (see the `#shorthands` marker import on `unstyled.ts`).
 */
export interface VfSelectProps<TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends OptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown> extends SelectProps<'select', TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TOptionValueReturn, VfSelectSlots<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>, VfSelectParts, VfSelectClasses, VfSelectContext<VfSelectProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>>> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfSelect component, parameterized by the option-driving
 * type arguments so event handlers (e.g. `@change`) receive the narrowed
 * context — same pattern as `VfSelectSlots`. Plain usage (`VfSelectEmits`)
 * keeps the context wide.
 */
export interface VfSelectEmits<TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends OptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown> extends SelectEmits<VfSelectContext<VfSelectProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>>> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfSelect component.
 *
 * `#template` is generic-aware; forwarded PrimeVue slot shapes use wide
 * item/model types.
 */
export interface VfSelectSlots<TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends OptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown> extends SelectSlots<VfSelectContext<VfSelectProps<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>>>, FloatLabelSlots, IftaSlots, AddonsSlots, IconsSlots, OverrideSlots<ForwardedSlots<ASelectSlots, (typeof forwards.slots)[number]>, {
    /**
     * Custom value template.
     */
    value: (props: {
        /**
         * Value of the component.
         */
        value: any;
        /**
         * Placeholder prop value.
         */
        placeholder: string;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Custom header template of panel.
     */
    header: (props: {
        /**
         * Value of the component.
         */
        value: any;
        /**
         * Displayed options.
         */
        options: any[];
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Custom footer template of panel.
     */
    footer: (props: {
        /**
         * Value of the component.
         */
        value: any;
        /**
         * Displayed options.
         */
        options: any[];
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Custom option template.
     */
    option: (props: {
        /**
         * The raw option item.
         */
        option: any;
        /**
         * Selection state.
         */
        selected: boolean;
        /**
         * Index of the option.
         */
        index: number;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Custom option group template.
     */
    optiongroup: (props: {
        /**
         * The raw option group (or raw item when ungrouped).
         */
        option: any;
        /**
         * Index of the option group.
         */
        index: number;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Custom content template.
     */
    content: (props: {
        /**
         * An array of objects to display for virtualscroller.
         */
        items: any[];
        /**
         * Style class of the component.
         */
        styleClass: string;
        /**
         * Reference of the content.
         */
        contentRef: (el: any) => void;
        /**
         * Options of the items.
         */
        getItemOptions: (index: number) => VirtualScrollerItemOptions;
    }) => VNode[];
}> {
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfSelect component.
 */
export interface VfSelectParts extends SelectParts, AddonsParts, AddonGroupParts, IconsParts, FloatLabelParts, IftaParts {
    /**
     * The select input element.
     *
     * @tag Select
     */
    input: PvSelectProps;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfSelect component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfSelectClasses extends SelectClasses, FloatLabelClasses, IftaClasses {
    /**
     * The select input element.
     */
    input: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfSelect.
 *
 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `SelectExpose` for all select-based components) so they
 * appear on `ContextOf<'VfSelect'>` / `context$` / `defineExpose`.
 */
export interface VfSelectExpose extends SelectExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfSelect, optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * `VfSelectContext<VfSelectProps<typeof options, 'id'>>`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 */
export interface VfSelectContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfSelectProps, SelectProps<string, OptionsProp, OptionValueProp, OptionGroupChildrenProp>> = VfSelectProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfSelectEmits, VfSelectSlots, VfSelectParts, VfSelectClasses, VfSelectExpose, SelectApi<TProps>> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfSelect. `TEntry` narrows the props / emits / context by
 * the entry's option-driving props, the same way SFC generics do.
 */
export interface VfSelectEntry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<EntryProps<TEntry>, VfSelectEmits<EntryOptionsOf<TEntry>, EntryOptionValueKeyOf<TEntry>, EntryOptionGroupChildrenOf<TEntry>, EntryMultipleOf<TEntry>, any, EntryOptionValueReturnOf<TEntry>>, VfSelectSlots, VfSelectParts, VfSelectClasses, VfSelectContext<EntryProps<TEntry>>> {
}

export * from './index';

    interface ControlRegistry<TEntry> {
        VfSelect: VfSelectEntry<TEntry>;
    }
}
declare module 'vue' {
    interface GlobalComponents {
        VfSelect: typeof VfSelect;
    }
}

import { SliderApi, SliderClasses, SliderEmits, SliderExpose, SliderParts, SliderProps, SliderSlots } from '../../blueprints/slider';
import { ClassValue, DefineElementContext, DefineRegistryEntry, EntryPropOf, WidenProps } from '@vueform/core';
import { SliderProps as PvSliderProps } from 'primevue';
/**
 * Resolves a `TRange` generic from a registry `TEntry` payload's `range` prop,
 * defaulting to `false` when absent or invalid.
 */
export type EntryRangeOf<TEntry> = EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'range'> extends infer R ? R extends boolean ? R : false : false;
/**
 * VfSlider props narrowed from a registry `TEntry` payload, applying the
 * entry's `range` prop as a generic.
 */
export type EntryProps<TEntry> = VfSliderProps<EntryRangeOf<TEntry>>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the VfSlider component, parameterized by the
 * model-driving type argument (e.g. `VfSliderProps<true>`). Reach for
 * `VfSliderProps` instead when no narrowing is needed.
 *
 * The `part:*` / `class:*` / `reclass:*` shorthand attrs are injected into dist
 * by `@vueform/utils` (see the `#shorthands` marker import on `unstyled.ts`).
 */
export interface VfSliderProps<TRange extends boolean = boolean> extends SliderProps<'slider', TRange, VfSliderSlots<TRange>, VfSliderParts, VfSliderClasses, VfSliderContext<VfSliderProps<TRange>>> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfSlider component, parameterized by the model-driving
 * type argument so event handlers (e.g. `@change`) receive the narrowed context
 * — same pattern as `VfSliderSlots`. Plain usage (`VfSliderEmits`) keeps the
 * context wide.
 */
export interface VfSliderEmits<TRange extends boolean = boolean> extends SliderEmits<VfSliderContext<VfSliderProps<TRange>>> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfSlider component.
 */
export interface VfSliderSlots<TRange extends boolean = boolean> extends SliderSlots<VfSliderContext<VfSliderProps<TRange>>> {
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfSlider component.
 */
export interface VfSliderParts extends SliderParts {
    /**
     * The slider element.
     *
     * @tag Slider
     */
    input: PvSliderProps;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfSlider component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfSliderClasses extends SliderClasses {
    /**
     * The slider element.
     */
    input: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfSlider.
 *
 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `SliderExpose` for all slider-based components) so they
 * appear on `ContextOf<'VfSlider'>` / `context$` / `defineExpose`.
 */
export interface VfSliderExpose extends SliderExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfSlider, optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * `VfSliderContext<VfSliderProps<true>>`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).

    input: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfToggleButton.
 *
 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `ToggleButtonExpose` for all toggle-button-based
 * components) so they appear on `ContextOf<'VfToggleButton'>` / `context$` /
 * `defineExpose`.
 */
export interface VfToggleButtonExpose extends ToggleButtonExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfToggleButton.
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 *
 * Non-generic: no `TProps` parameter — the api has nothing to narrow from
 * props, so the context is a fixed `DefineElementContext` instantiation.
 */
export interface VfToggleButtonContext extends DefineElementContext<VfToggleButtonProps, VfToggleButtonEmits, VfToggleButtonSlots, VfToggleButtonParts, VfToggleButtonClasses, VfToggleButtonExpose, ToggleButtonApi> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfToggleButton. `TEntry` is accepted for registry
 * uniformity but does not narrow anything — VfToggleButton has no prop-driven
 * generics.
 */
export interface VfToggleButtonEntry<_TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<VfToggleButtonProps, VfToggleButtonEmits, VfToggleButtonSlots, VfToggleButtonParts, VfToggleButtonClasses, VfToggleButtonContext> {
}

/**
 * Resolves the `TOptions` generic from a registry `TEntry` payload's `options`
 * prop. Missing / invalid values fall back to the unconstrained
 * `TreeOptionsProp`. Literal tree keys are preserved so `TreeSelectModel` can
 * narrow selection-key maps.
 */
export type EntryTreeOptionsOf<TEntry> = EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'options'> extends infer I ? [I] extends [undefined] ? TreeOptionsProp : UnwrapEntryRef<I> extends infer U extends TreeOptionsProp ? U : TreeOptionsProp : TreeOptionsProp;
/**
 * Resolves the `TSelectionMode` generic from a registry `TEntry` payload's
 * `selectionMode` prop, defaulting to `undefined` when absent or invalid.
 */
export type EntrySelectionModeOf<TEntry> = EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'selectionMode'> extends infer M ? M extends TreeSelectionModeProp ? M : undefined : undefined;
/**
 * VfTreeSelect props narrowed from a registry `TEntry` payload, applying the
 * entry's `options` / `selectionMode` props as generics.
 */
export type EntryProps<TEntry> = VfTreeSelectProps<EntryTreeOptionsOf<TEntry>, EntrySelectionModeOf<TEntry>>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the VfTreeSelect component, parameterized by the
 * tree-option / selection-mode type arguments (e.g. `VfTreeSelectProps<typeof
 * options, 'checkbox'>`). Reach for `VfTreeSelectProps` instead when no
 * narrowing is needed.
 *
 * The `part:*` / `class:*` / `reclass:*` shorthand attrs are injected into dist
 * by `@vueform/utils` (see the `#shorthands` marker import on `unstyled.ts`).
 */

}

//// directives/tooltip.d.ts
/**
 * Vapor-compatible PrimeVue Tooltip directive. Vapor custom directives are
 * functions `(el, valueGetter, arg, modifiers) => cleanup`, while PrimeVue
 * ships a VDOM ObjectDirective — this adapter bridges the two.
 *
 * @param el The host DOM element (or vapor component root element).
 * @param value Reactive getter for the directive binding value.
 * @param argument Directive argument string.
 * @param modifiers Directive modifiers map.
 */
declare function vaporTooltip(el: Element, value?: () => any, argument?: string, modifiers?: Record<string, boolean>): () => void;
/**
 * Tooltip directive for Vueform PrimeVue components. Resolves to PrimeVue's
 * VDOM ObjectDirective in the main dist, or a vapor function directive in the
 * vapor dist / vapor playground / vapor tests (`__VUEFORM_VAPOR__`).
 */
export declare const vTooltip: import('vue').ObjectDirective<any, any, string, any> | typeof vaporTooltip;
export {};

//// features/aria/makeAria.d.ts
import { AriaProp, ReturnsOf, makeData, makeLayout } from '@vueform/core';
import { makeFloatLabel, makeIfta } from '..';
/**
 * Configuration for the PrimeVue ARIA factory wiring describedby with float
 * label and IFTA awareness.
 */
type MakeAriaOptions = {
    props: {
        aria: AriaProp | undefined;
    };
    deps: ReturnsOf<[
        [
            typeof makeLayout,
            [
                'labelId',
                'helpId',
                'descriptionId',
                'errorId',
                'label',
                'help',
                'description'
            ]
        ],
        [
            typeof makeData,
            ['hasError', 'busy', 'required']
        ]
    ], [
        [typeof makeFloatLabel, ['floatLabel']],
        [typeof makeIfta, ['ifta']]
    ]>;
};
/**
 * Provides computed ARIA attributes for PrimeVue adapter elements, including
 * float-label and IFTA-aware describedby that references the label region when
 * the input uses a floating or in-field label.
 *
 * @param options Factory options containing element props and dependencies.
 */
export declare const makeAria: (config?: unknown) => (options: MakeAriaOptions) => {
    aria: import('vue').ComputedRef<{
        'aria-labelledby'?: string;
        'aria-describedby': string;
        'aria-required': boolean;
        'aria-invalid': boolean;
        'aria-busy': boolean;
    }>;
};
export {};

    interface BaseElementParts {
        /**

         * step or a tab.

         * @tag TabPanel
         */
        panel?: TabPanelProps;
        /**
         * The element's root wrapper.
         *
         * @tag div | fieldset
         */
        root?: DOMAttrs['div' | 'fieldset'];
        /**
         * The container holding the label and required indicator.
         *
         * @tag div | legend
         */
        labelGroup?: DOMAttrs['div' | 'legend'];
        /**
         * The label element.
         *
         * @tag label | span | h1 | h2 | h3 | h4 | h5 | h6
         */
        label?: DOMAttrs['label' | 'span' | 'h1' | 'h2' | 'h3' | 'h4' | 'h5' | 'h6'];
        /**

         *
         * @tag div
         */
        required?: DOMAttrs['div'];
        /**
         * Info container.
         *
         * @tag div
         */
        info?: DOMAttrs['div'];

         *
         * @tag span
         */
        infoIcon?: DOMAttrs['span'];

         * The container wrapping the input and related UI.
         *
         * @tag div | TabsProps
         */
        elementGroup?: DOMAttrs['div'] | TabsProps;
        /**
         * The wrapper directly around the input control.
         *
         * @tag div
         */
        elementWrapper?: DOMAttrs['div'];
        /**
         * The help text area.
         *
         * @tag Message
         */
        help?: MessageProps & Record<string, any>;
        /**
         * The description text area.
         *
         * @tag Message
         */
        description?: MessageProps & Record<string, any>;
        /**
         * The validation errors container.
         *
         * @tag Message
         */
        errors?: MessageProps & Record<string, any>;
        /**
         * An individual validation error.
         *
         * @tag div
         */
        error?: DOMAttrs['div'];
        /**
         * The info messages container.
         *
         * @tag div
         */
        messages?: DOMAttrs['div'];
        /**
         * An individual info message.
         *
         * @tag div
         */
        message?: DOMAttrs['div'];
    }
    interface BaseElementSlots {
        /**

         *
         * @param props.label The resolved label text.
         */
        label: (props: {
            label?: string;
        }) => VNode[];
        /**
         * Slot for customizing the required indicator.
         */
        required: () => VNode[];
        /**
         * Slot for customizing the help text.
         *
         * @param props.help The resolved help text.
         */
        help: (props: {
            help?: string;
        }) => VNode[];
        /**
         * Slot for customizing the description text.
         *
         * @param props.description The resolved description text.
         */
        description: (props: {
            description?: string;
        }) => VNode[];
        /**

         *
         * @param props.errors The list of validation error messages.
         */
        errors: (props: {
            errors: string[];
        }) => VNode[];
        /**
         * Slot for customizing the info messages display.
         *
         * @param props.messages The list of info messages.
         */
        messages: (props: {
            messages: string[];
        }) => VNode[];
        /**
         * Slot for customizing the info tooltip or helper content.
         *
         * @param props.info The info text.
         */
        info: (props: {
            info?: string;
        }) => VNode[];
    }
    interface BaseElementClasses {
        /**

         */
        root: (props: {
            spaceTop?: number;

        panel: ClassValue;

        labelGroup: (heading?: HeadingProp) => ClassValue;
        /**
         * The label element.
         */
        label: ClassValue;
        /**
         * The required indicator.
         */
        required: ClassValue;
        /**
         * The info tooltip or helper wrapper.
         */
        info: ClassValue;
        /**
         * The info icon element.
         */
        infoIcon: ClassValue;
        /**
         * The help text area.
         */
        help: ClassValue;
        /**
         * The info tooltip.
         */
        infoTooltip: ClassValue;
        /**
         * The container wrapping the input and related UI.
         */
        elementGroup: ClassValue;
        /**
         * The wrapper directly around the input control.
         */
        elementWrapper: ClassValue;

//// features/default-value/types.d.ts
import { ModelProps } from '@vueform/core';
/**
 * `ModelProps` plus a PrimeVue-style `defaultValue` prop (same type as
 * `modelValue`).
 */
export interface ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<T = any, TContext = any> extends ModelProps<T, TContext> {
    /**
     * The default/initial value of the element.
     */
    defaultValue?: T;
}
/**
 * Props for the element's default/initial value (PrimeVue `defaultValue`
 * naming).
 *
 * @deprecated Use `ModelPropsWithDefaultValue` instead.
 */
export type DefaultValueProps<T = any> = Pick<ModelPropsWithDefaultValue<T>, 'defaultValue'>;

//// features/interval/makeInterval.d.ts
import { DProp, makeData, ReturnsOf } from '@vueform/core';
/**
 * Configuration for the interval factory resolving min, max, and step
 * boundaries.
 */
type MakeIntervalOptions = {
    /**
     * The element's prop values used for interval resolution.
     */
    props: {
        /**
         * Minimum boundary value. Accepts expressions.
         */
        min: DProp<number> | undefined;
        /**
         * Maximum boundary value. Accepts expressions.
         */
        max: DProp<number> | undefined;
        /**
         * Step factor to increment/decrement the value. Accepts expressions.
         */
        step: DProp<number> | undefined;
    };
    /**
     * Resolved dependencies from earlier factories.
     */
    deps: ReturnsOf<[[typeof makeData, ['update', 'value']]]>;
};
/**
 * Resolves dynamic min, max, and step boundaries and clamps the element value
 * when the resolved bounds change.
 *
 * @param options Factory options containing element props and resolved
 *   dependencies.
 */
export declare const makeInterval: (config?: unknown) => (options: MakeIntervalOptions) => {
    min: import('vue').ComputedRef<number | undefined>;
    max: import('vue').ComputedRef<number | undefined>;
    step: import('vue').ComputedRef<number | undefined>;
};
export {};

//// features/interval/types.d.ts
import { DProp } from '@vueform/core';

 * Interval-related props mixed into element components that support min, max,
 * and step boundaries (e.g. slider, knob, input-number).
 */

    /**
     * Minimum boundary value. Accepts expressions.
     */
    min?: DProp<number>;
    /**
     * Maximum boundary value. Accepts expressions.
     */
    max?: DProp<number>;
    /**
     * Step factor to increment/decrement the value. Accepts expressions.
     */
    step?: DProp<number>;
}

        languages: ResolvedLanguagesProp;
        language: string;
        invalidLanguages: Set<string>;
        select: (language: string) => void;
        class: ClassValue;
    }) => VNode[];

     * Slot that replaces each individual language tab.

        value: string;

        selected: boolean;
        invalid: boolean;
        class: ClassValue;

//// features/options/index.d.ts
export type * from './types';

//// features/options/types.d.ts
import { AllowedItemValueKey, AllowsItemKeyProps, ConditionalProp, ConditionsTriggerProp, EntryItemsOf, EntryItemValueKeyOf, EntryItemValueReturnOf, EntryPropOf, GroupKeyProp, GroupOf, ItemKeyProp, ItemsGenericsBrand, ItemValueOf, ItemValueProp, ItemsModel, ItemsModelApi, ItemsModelProp, ItemsProp, RawItemOf, ResolvedItem } from '@vueform/core';
import { MaybeRef } from 'vue';
/**
 * Allowed types for the `options` prop. PrimeVue-named counterpart of core
 * `ItemsProp`.
 */
export type OptionsProp<TContext = any> = ItemsProp<TContext>;
/**
 * Bound for the `TOptionValueKey` generic of options-based elements: a string
 * option key, or `undefined` when unset.
 *
 * PrimeVue-named counterpart of core `ItemValueProp`.
 */
export type OptionValueProp = ItemValueProp;
/**
 * Allowed type for option key props (`optionLabel`, `optionDisabled`, etc.).
 * PrimeVue-named counterpart of core `ItemKeyProp`.
 */
export type OptionKeyProp<TOptions, TGroupChildren, TReturn> = ItemKeyProp<TOptions, TGroupChildren, TReturn>;
/**
 * Allowed string keys for `optionValue` on the resolved option shape.
 * PrimeVue-named counterpart of core `AllowedItemValueKey`.
 */
export type AllowedOptionValueKey<TOptions, TGroupChildren = undefined> = AllowedItemValueKey<TOptions, TGroupChildren>;
/**
 * Whether option/group key props are allowed for the given `options` shape.
 * PrimeVue-named counterpart of core `AllowsItemKeyProps`.
 */
export type AllowsOptionKeyProps<TOptions> = AllowsItemKeyProps<TOptions>;
/**
 * The effective raw option type resolved from `options` (and optional
 * `optionGroupChildren`). PrimeVue-named counterpart of core `RawItemOf`.
 */
export type RawOptionOf<TOptions, TGroupChildren = undefined> = RawItemOf<TOptions, TGroupChildren>;
/**
 * The selected value type derived from `options` and an optional `optionValue`
 * key / mapper return. PrimeVue-named counterpart of core `ItemValueOf`.
 */
export type OptionValueOf<TOptions, TOptionValueKey = undefined, TGroupChildren = undefined, TOptionValueReturn = unknown> = ItemValueOf<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TOptionValueReturn>;
/**
 * The group object type extracted from an array of groups. PrimeVue-named
 * counterpart of core `GroupOf`.
 */
export type OptionGroupOf<TOptions> = GroupOf<TOptions>;
/**
 * Allowed type for option-group key props. PrimeVue-named counterpart of core
 * `GroupKeyProp`.
 */
export type OptionGroupKeyProp<TOptions, TReturn> = GroupKeyProp<TOptions, TReturn>;
/**
 * The model value type for an options-based element. PrimeVue-named counterpart
 * of core `ItemsModel`.
 */
export type OptionsModel<TOptions, TOptionValueKey = undefined, TGroupChildren = undefined, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown> = ItemsModel<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>;
/**
 * Model / default prop type for options-based elements. PrimeVue-named
 * counterpart of core `ItemsModelProp`.
 */
export type OptionsModelProp<TOptions, TOptionValueKey = undefined, TGroupChildren = undefined, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, TOptionValueReturn = unknown> = ItemsModelProp<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TOptionValueReturn>;
/**
 * Factory API overlay that specializes model members from options generics.
 * PrimeVue-named counterpart of core `ItemsModelApi`.
 */
export type OptionsModelApi<Base, P> = ItemsModelApi<Base, P>;
/**
 * Type-only brand carrying `OptionsProps` generics for `makeItems` consumers.
 * PrimeVue-named counterpart of core `ItemsGenericsBrand`.
 */
export type OptionsGenericsBrand<TOptions = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey = undefined, TGroupChildren = undefined, TOptionValueReturn = unknown> = ItemsGenericsBrand<TOptions, TOptionValueKey, TGroupChildren, TOptionValueReturn>;
/**
 * A normalized option with resolved value, label, and disabled state.
 * PrimeVue-named counterpart of core `ResolvedItem`.
 */
export type ResolvedOption<TValue = any, TRaw = Record<string, any>> = ResolvedItem<TValue, TRaw>;
/**
 * Remaps PrimeVue option prop names on a registry `TEntry` payload to the core
 * items keys that the core `Entry*Of` helpers read (`options` → `items`,
 * `optionValue` → `itemValue`, `optionGroupChildren` → `groupChildren`).
 *
 * Prefer the PrimeVue-named wrappers (`EntryOptionsOf`,
 * `EntryOptionValueKeyOf`, `EntryOptionValueReturnOf`,
 * `EntryOptionGroupChildrenOf`) at call sites.
 */
export type OptionsEntry<TEntry> = {
    items: EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'options'>;
    itemValue: EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'optionValue'>;
    groupChildren: EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'optionGroupChildren'>;
};
/**
 * Resolves the `TOptions` generic from a registry `TEntry` payload's `options`
 * prop — the PrimeVue-named counterpart of core `EntryItemsOf`.
 */
export type EntryOptionsOf<TEntry> = EntryItemsOf<OptionsEntry<TEntry>>;
/**
 * Resolves the `TOptionValueKey` generic from a registry `TEntry` payload's
 * `optionValue` prop — the string-key arm only (mapper returns are typed via
 * `EntryOptionValueReturnOf`). The PrimeVue-named counterpart of core
 * `EntryItemValueKeyOf`.
 */
export type EntryOptionValueKeyOf<TEntry> = EntryItemValueKeyOf<OptionsEntry<TEntry>>;
/**
 * Resolves the `TOptionValueReturn` generic from a registry `TEntry` payload's
 * `optionValue` prop — the mapper-return arm (`unknown` = unset). The
 * PrimeVue-named counterpart of core `EntryItemValueReturnOf`.
 */
export type EntryOptionValueReturnOf<TEntry> = EntryItemValueReturnOf<OptionsEntry<TEntry>>;
/**
 * Resolves the `TGroupChildren` generic from a registry `TEntry` payload's
 * `optionGroupChildren` prop, coerced to `TBound`. The PrimeVue-named
 * counterpart of core `EntryGroupChildrenOf`.
 *
 * Cascade-select elements pass `CascadeOptionGroupChildrenProp` as `TBound` to
 * also admit nested path arrays.
 */
export type EntryOptionGroupChildrenOf<TEntry, TBound = OptionGroupChildrenProp> = EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'optionGroupChildren'> extends infer G ? G extends TBound ? G : undefined : undefined;
/**
 * Allowed keys / mappers for `optionGroupChildren`.
 *
 * Same as core `AllowedGroupChildren`, except mapper returns are restricted to
 * arrays — PrimeVue's Select (and related) `optionGroupChildren` prop only
 * accepts `any[]`, not record maps.
 */
export type AllowedOptionGroupChildren<TOptions> = [
    OptionGroupOf<TOptions>
] extends [never] ? string | ((group: any) => any[]) : Extract<keyof OptionGroupOf<TOptions>, string> | ((group: OptionGroupOf<TOptions>) => any[]);
/**
 * Bound for the `TGroupChildren` generic of options-based elements: a group
 * key, a function mapping a group to a children array, or `undefined` when
 * unset.
 *
 * Intentionally simple so component `generic="…"` declarations stay readable.
 * Whether a key is actually valid for the current `options` shape is enforced
 * by the `optionGroupChildren` prop type itself (via
 * `AllowedOptionGroupChildren`), not by this bound.
 */
export type OptionGroupChildrenProp = string | ((group: any) => any[]) | undefined;
/**
 * CascadeSelect also accepts a nested path array (e.g. `['states', 'cities']`)
 * for `optionGroupChildren`.
 */
export type AllowedCascadeOptionGroupChildren<TOptions> = AllowedOptionGroupChildren<TOptions> | string[];
/**
 * Bound for the `TGroupChildren` generic of cascade-select elements: a group
 * key, a nested path array, a function mapping a group to a children array, or
 * `undefined` when unset.
 *
 * The cascade counterpart of `OptionGroupChildrenProp` — intentionally simple
 * so component `generic="…"` declarations stay readable. Whether a key or path
 * is actually valid for the current `options` shape is enforced by the
 * `optionGroupChildren` prop type itself (via
 * `AllowedCascadeOptionGroupChildren`), not by this bound.
 */
export type CascadeOptionGroupChildrenProp = string | string[] | ((group: any) => any[]) | undefined;
/**
 * Props for PrimeVue options-based elements (`options` / `option*` naming).
 *
 * Same generics and inference rules as core `ItemsProps`, with PrimeVue prop
 * names. Model typing uses `OptionsModel` / `OptionsModelProp`.
 *
 * `optionValue` is split across two generics so Vue can contextually type the
 * mapper's `option` argument from `options` while still inferring the return
 * type into the model:
 *
 * - `TOptionValueKey` — string property key
 * - `TOptionValueReturn` — mapper return type (defaults to `unknown` = unset)
 */
export interface OptionsProps<TOptions extends OptionsProp = OptionsProp, TOptionValueKey extends OptionValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends OptionGroupChildrenProp = undefined, TOptionValueReturn = unknown, TContext = any> {
    /**
     * The option items for the element.
     */
    options?: MaybeRef<TOptions>;
    /**
     * Resolves the label for an option. A string key for property lookup, or a
     * function returning the label string. Not allowed for plain scalar arrays or
     * plain object/record maps.
     */
    optionLabel?: OptionKeyProp<TOptions, TGroupChildren, string>;
    /**
     * Resolves the value for an option. A string key for property lookup, or a
     * function returning the value. Not allowed for plain scalar arrays or plain
     * object/record maps.
     *
     * Typed as `(TOptionValueKey & AllowedOptionValueKey) | AllowedOptionValueKey
     *
     * | ((option) => TOptionValueReturn)` so:
     *
     * - string keys infer into `TOptionValueKey` through the intersection, which
     *   also rejects keys missing from the option shape (the generic itself is
     *   only bounded by the simple `OptionValueProp`, so validation must happen
     *   here)
     * - keys remain assignable on the defaulted `ElementSchema` / `FormSchema`
     *   surface where `TOptionValueKey` is still `undefined`
     * - mapper return types infer into `TOptionValueReturn`
     * - the `option` parameter stays concrete and is contextually typed even for
     *   bare inline arrows (whose return type cannot drive generics under Vue's
     *   single-pass inference — annotate the param or use a named function for
     *   full model inference)
     */
    optionValue?: AllowsOptionKeyProps<TOptions> extends true ? (TOptionValueKey & AllowedOptionValueKey<TOptions, TGroupChildren>) | AllowedOptionValueKey<TOptions, TGroupChildren> | ((option: RawOptionOf<TOptions, TGroupChildren>) => TOptionValueReturn) : never;
    /**
     * Determines whether an option is disabled. A string key for property lookup,
     * or a function returning a `ConditionalProp`. Not allowed for plain scalar
     * arrays or plain object/record maps.
     */
    optionDisabled?: OptionKeyProp<TOptions, TGroupChildren, ConditionalProp<TContext> | undefined>;
    /**
     * Determines whether an option is available. A string key for property
     * lookup, or a function returning a `ConditionalProp`. Options whose
     * conditions are not met are omitted from the list. Not allowed for plain
     * scalar arrays or plain object/record maps.
     */
    optionConditions?: OptionKeyProp<TOptions, TGroupChildren, ConditionalProp<TContext> | undefined>;
    /**
     * Resolves the label for an option group. A string key for property lookup on
     * the group object, or a function returning the label string. Not allowed for
     * plain scalar arrays or plain object/record maps.
     */
    optionGroupLabel?: OptionGroupKeyProp<TOptions, string>;
    /**
     * Resolves the children items for an option group. A string key for property
     * lookup on the group object, or a function returning a children array. Not
     * allowed for plain scalar arrays or plain object/record maps.
     *
     * Mapper returns are restricted to arrays to match PrimeVue's
     * `optionGroupChildren` prop.
     *
     * The intersection arm infers keys into `TGroupChildren` while rejecting keys
     * missing from the group shape (the generic itself is only bounded by the
     * simple `OptionGroupChildrenProp`). The bare `AllowedOptionGroupChildren`
     * arm keeps keys assignable on the defaulted schema surface where
     * `TGroupChildren` is still `undefined`.
     */
    optionGroupChildren?: AllowsOptionKeyProps<TOptions> extends true ? (TGroupChildren & AllowedOptionGroupChildren<TOptions>) | AllowedOptionGroupChildren<TOptions> : never;
    /**
     * Determines whether an option group is available. A string key for property
     * lookup on the group object, or a function returning a `ConditionalProp`.
     * Groups whose conditions are not met are omitted entirely. Not allowed for
     * plain scalar arrays or plain object/record maps.
     */
    optionGroupConditions?: OptionGroupKeyProp<TOptions, ConditionalProp<TContext> | undefined>;
    /**
     * Custom HTTP headers to include when loading options from an endpoint.
     */
    headers?: Record<string, string>;
    /**
     * The HTTP method to use when loading options from an endpoint. Defaults to
     * `'GET'`.
     */
    method?: string;
    /**
     * The source that triggers re-resolution of function-based options. Accepts
     * an array of element paths whose values are watched, a `Ref`, or a function
     * used as a watch getter. When omitted, function-based options are only
     * re-resolved when the `options` prop reference itself changes.
     */
    optionsTrigger?: ConditionsTriggerProp;
    /**
     * The debounce delay in milliseconds applied before re-resolving
     * function-based options when the `optionsTrigger` source changes. Defaults
     * to no debounce (immediate re-resolution).
     */
    optionsDebounce?: number;
    /**
     * Transforms data received from an endpoint into the options format. When
     * `options` is a string (endpoint URL), the HTTP response data is passed
     * through this function before normalization.
     */
    transformOptions?: (data: any) => any[] | Record<string, any>;
}

        optionDisabled?: ItemDisabled;

        optionsDebounce?: number;

//// features/suggestions/types.d.ts
import { OptionKeyProp, OptionsProp } from '../options';
import { ConditionalProp, ConditionsTriggerProp, EntryItemsOf, EntryPropOf } from '@vueform/core';
import { MaybeRef } from 'vue';
/**
 * Allowed types for the `suggestions` prop. PrimeVue AutoComplete counterpart
 * of `OptionsProp`.
 */
export type SuggestionsProp<TContext = any> = OptionsProp<TContext>;
/**
 * Resolves the `TSuggestions` generic from a registry `TEntry` payload's
 * `suggestions` prop — the AutoComplete counterpart of core `EntryItemsOf`.
 */
export type EntrySuggestionsOf<TEntry> = EntryItemsOf<{
    items: EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'suggestions'>;
}>;
/**
 * Props for PrimeVue AutoComplete-style elements (`suggestions` naming).
 *
 * Same options→model inference as `OptionsProps`, but:
 *
 * - the source prop is `suggestions` (not `options`)
 * - there is no `optionValue` — the model is the whole suggestion option (or
 *   scalar), matching core when `itemValue` is omitted
 */
export interface SuggestionsProps<TSuggestions extends SuggestionsProp = SuggestionsProp, TContext = any> {
    /**
     * The suggestion items for the element.
     */
    suggestions?: MaybeRef<TSuggestions>;
    /**
     * Resolves the label for a suggestion. A string key for property lookup, or a
     * function returning the label string. Not allowed for plain scalar arrays or
     * plain object/record maps.
     */
    optionLabel?: OptionKeyProp<TSuggestions, undefined, string>;
    /**
     * Determines whether a suggestion is disabled. A string key for property
     * lookup, or a function returning a `ConditionalProp`. Not allowed for plain
     * scalar arrays or plain object/record maps.
     */
    optionDisabled?: OptionKeyProp<TSuggestions, undefined, ConditionalProp<TContext> | undefined>;
    /**
     * Custom HTTP headers to include when loading suggestions from an endpoint.
     */
    headers?: Record<string, string>;
    /**
     * The HTTP method to use when loading suggestions from an endpoint. Defaults
     * to `'GET'`.
     */
    method?: string;
    /**
     * The source that triggers re-resolution of function-based suggestions.
     * Accepts an array of element paths whose values are watched, a `Ref`, or a
     * function used as a watch getter. When omitted, function-based suggestions
     * are only re-resolved when the `suggestions` prop reference itself changes.
     */
    optionsTrigger?: ConditionsTriggerProp;
    /**
     * The debounce delay in milliseconds applied before re-resolving
     * function-based suggestions when the `optionsTrigger` source changes.
     * Defaults to no debounce (immediate re-resolution).
     */
    optionsDebounce?: number;
    /**
     * Transforms data received from an endpoint into the suggestions format. When
     * `suggestions` is a string (endpoint URL), the HTTP response data is passed
     * through this function before normalization.
     */
    transformOptions?: (data: any) => any[] | Record<string, any>;
}

//// features/tree-options/types.d.ts
import { TreeOptionsProp } from '../../types';
import { ConditionsTriggerProp, IsDefaultItems, UnwrappedItems } from '@vueform/core';
import { MaybeRef } from 'vue';
/**
 * Recursively collects `key` literals from a tree node array.
 */
type TreeKeysOfNodes<T> = T extends readonly (infer N)[] ? TreeKeysOfNode<N> : never;
/**
 * Keys from one tree node and its descendants.
 */
type TreeKeysOfNode<N> = (N extends {
    key: infer K extends string | number;
} ? K : never) | (N extends {
    children?: infer C;
} ? C extends readonly any[] ? TreeKeysOfNodes<C> : never : never);
/**
 * Whether `TOptions` is still the unconstrained `TreeOptionsProp` default.
 */
type IsDefaultTreeOptions<TOptions> = [TOptions] extends [TreeOptionsProp] ? [TreeOptionsProp] extends [TOptions] ? true : false : false;
/**
 * Checkbox selection metadata used by PrimeVue-style tree selection.
 */
export type TreeCheckboxSelectionMeta = {
    checked: boolean;
    partialChecked: boolean;
};
/**
 * Selection-keys model for a tree of nodes with `key` / `children`.
 *
 * - `selectionMode: 'checkbox'` → `{ [key]?: { checked; partialChecked } }`
 * - otherwise (`single` / `multiple` / unset) → `{ [key]?: true }`
 *
 * Empty selection is `{}` (not `null`). Endpoint / unconstrained items fall
 * back to `TModel`.
 */
export type TreeKeysModel<TOptions, TSelectionMode = undefined, TModel = any> = IsDefaultItems<TOptions> extends true ? TModel : UnwrappedItems<TOptions> extends string ? TModel : TreeKeysOfNodes<UnwrappedItems<TOptions>> extends infer Keys ? [Keys] extends [never] ? TModel : [
    Keys
] extends [string | number] ? TSelectionMode extends 'checkbox' ? Partial<Record<Keys & (string | number), TreeCheckboxSelectionMeta>> : Partial<Record<Keys & (string | number), true>> : TModel : TModel;
/**
 * Model / default prop type for tree-keys elements.
 *
 * Always includes `NoInfer<TreeKeysModel<…>>` so `modelValue` / `default` do
 * not compete with `options` / `selectionMode` when inferring generics.
 * Endpoint URL items also union in a naked `TModel` arm so `v-model` can still
 * drive `TModel`.
 */
export type TreeKeysModelProp<TOptions, TSelectionMode = undefined, TModel = any> = NoInfer<TreeKeysModel<TOptions, TSelectionMode, TModel>> | ([UnwrappedItems<TOptions>] extends [string] ? TModel : never);
/**
 * Bound for the `TSelectionMode` generic of tree-select elements: one of
 * PrimeVue's tree selection modes, or `undefined` when unset.
 *
 * Intentionally limited to the literal modes so a component instance's props
 * stay assignable to the component's canonical (defaulted) context.
 */
export type TreeSelectionModeProp = 'single' | 'multiple' | 'checkbox' | undefined;
/**
 * Resolved model value for a tree-select given `options` + `selectionMode`.
 *
 * Uses `TreeKeysModel` once a concrete options shape is known; falls back to
 * `TModel` for the unconstrained default / endpoint URLs.
 */
export type TreeSelectModel<TOptions extends TreeOptionsProp = TreeOptionsProp, TSelectionMode extends string | undefined = undefined, TModel = any> = IsDefaultTreeOptions<TOptions> extends true ? TModel : TreeKeysModel<TOptions, TSelectionMode, TModel>;
/**
 * Model / default prop type for tree-select (NoInfer + endpoint `TModel` arm).
 */
export type TreeSelectModelProp<TOptions extends TreeOptionsProp = TreeOptionsProp, TSelectionMode extends string | undefined = undefined, TModel = any> = IsDefaultTreeOptions<TOptions> extends true ? TModel : TreeKeysModelProp<TOptions, TSelectionMode, TModel>;
/**
 * Props for PrimeVue tree-select-style elements (`options` only — no
 * `optionValue` / `optionLabel`). Model typing uses `TreeSelectModel`.
 */
export interface TreeOptionsProps<TOptions extends TreeOptionsProp = TreeOptionsProp> {
    /**
     * The tree option items for the tree-select element. Accepts a static array
     * of tree nodes, an endpoint URL string, or a function returning tree nodes
     * (sync or async).
     */
    options?: MaybeRef<TOptions>;
    /**
     * Custom HTTP headers to include when loading options from an endpoint.
     */
    headers?: Record<string, string>;
    /**
     * The HTTP method to use when loading options from an endpoint. Defaults to
     * `'GET'`.
     */
    method?: string;
    /**
     * The source that triggers re-resolution of function-based options. Accepts
     * an array of element paths whose values are watched, a `Ref`, or a function
     * used as a watch getter. When omitted, function-based options are only
     * re-resolved when the `options` prop reference itself changes.
     */
    optionsTrigger?: ConditionsTriggerProp;
    /**
     * The debounce delay in milliseconds applied before re-resolving
     * function-based options when the `optionsTrigger` source changes. Defaults
     * to no debounce (immediate re-resolution).
     */
    optionsDebounce?: number;
    /**
     * Transforms data received from an endpoint into the tree node array format.
     * When `options` is a string (endpoint URL), the HTTP response data is passed
     * through this function before normalization.
     */
    transformOptions?: (data: any) => any[];
}
export {};

//// helpers/vdomPrime.d.ts
import { Component } from 'vue';
/**
 * Wrap a PrimeVue (VDOM / Options API) component so it can be used safely from
 * vapor-compiled Vueform SFCs.
 *
 * In the main (VDOM) build this is a no-op and returns `component` unchanged —
 * no extra instance layer. In the vapor build / vapor playground / vapor tests
 * (`__VUEFORM_VAPOR__`) it returns a VDOM `defineComponent` + `h()` host: vapor
 * interop mounts the bridge, and the bridge renders PrimeVue in a pure VDOM
 * tree where props, events, slots, and instance methods work normally.
 *
 * Direct vapor → PrimeVue nesting has known interop gaps: props from Options
 * API `extends` chains (e.g. `fluid`) fall through as DOM attributes, some
 * components render as `<!--[object Object]-->`, and tags like `<Button>` /
 * `<Select>` collide with HTML elements under Vapor's case-insensitive check.
 *
 * Parent template refs receive a Proxy of the inner PrimeVue instance so calls
 * like `input.value.show()` keep working. The proxy is marked `__v_skip` so
 * Vue's reactivity traverse does not walk the Options API instance graph (which
 * is circular and overflows the stack).
 *
 * Template aliases such as `VdomPrimeSelect` still resolve correctly in VDOM
 * mode — resolution uses the script binding, not `component.name`.
 */
export declare function vdomPrime<C extends Component>(component: C, name?: string): C;

/**
 * Type-safe helper for authoring a complete PrimeVue-adapter theme from
 * scratch. Every token of the built-in theme must be defined — a missing or
 * mistyped key surfaces as a type error — and an explicit `dark` block is
 * required (pass `{}` to opt out of a dark variant). Extra custom tokens are
 * accepted alongside the built-in set. To derive a theme from the existing one
 * instead, use `extendTheme`; to author a theme with your own token structure
 * (for a custom visual layer), use the structure-agnostic `defineTheme` from
 * the root entry.
 *
 * @param definition The complete theme definition.
 */
export declare function defineTheme<T extends CompleteTheme<typeof theme>>(definition: T): T;
export { extendTheme } from '@vueform/core';

//// types/shared.d.ts
import { ConditionalProp } from '@vueform/core';
import { TreeNode as PvTreeNode } from 'primevue/treenode';
/**
 * Floating label behavior mode for PrimeVue input components.
 */
export type FloatProp = 'in' | 'on';
/**
 * Position of a tooltip relative to its target element.
 */
export type TooltipPosProp = 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right';
/**
 * Position of an info popup relative to its target element.
 */
export type InfoPositionProp = TooltipPosProp;
export type TreeNode = PvTreeNode & {
    conditions?: ConditionalProp;
};
/**
 * Allowed types for the tree-select `options` prop: a static array of tree
 * nodes, an endpoint URL string, or a function returning tree nodes (sync or
 * async). Arrays may be mutable or `readonly` / `as const` tuples so literal
 * key unions can drive selection-keys model inference.
 *
 * The array arm is `readonly any[]` (not `TreeNode[]`) so `as const` trees —
 * whose nested `children` are readonly — remain assignable.
 */
export type TreeOptionsProp = readonly any[] | string | ((context$: any) => any);

//// types/shorthands.d.ts
/**
 * Marker module resolved by the `#shorthands` alias.
 *
 * Component `unstyled.ts` files import this so readers know shorthand prop
 * types (`part:*` / `class:*` / `reclass:*`) are injected at build time into
 * dist by `@vueform/utils`. The source module is empty; the plugin rewrites the
 * import in emitted `unstyled.d.ts` and writes the real declaration merge next
 * to it.
 */
export {};

//// types/utils.d.ts
import { LooseContext, CamelCase } from '@vueform/core';
/**
 * Picks the listed events from an emit interface and converts them to Vueform
 * event tuples with camelCased keys and `context$` appended as the last
 * argument.
 */
export type ForwardedEmits<TEmits, TKeys extends keyof TEmits = keyof TEmits, TContext = LooseContext> = {
    [K in TKeys as CamelCase<K & string>]: TEmits[K] extends (...args: infer A) => any ? [...A, context$: TContext] : [context$: TContext];
};
export type ForwardedSlots<TSlots, TKeys extends keyof TSlots = keyof TSlots> = {
    [K in TKeys]: TSlots[K];
};
/**
 * Replaces selected keys on a slot map while keeping the remaining forwarded
 * slots intact.
 */
export type OverrideSlots<TBase, TOverrides> = Omit<TBase, keyof TOverrides> & TOverrides;
/**
 * Intersects a PrimeVue component's Props with all valid `pt:` shorthand
 * attributes (e.g. `pt:root:class`, `pt:pc-toggle-button:root:class`).
 *
 * @example
 *   ;```ts
 *   input: WithPtShorthands<PvSelectButtonProps>
 *   ```
 */
export type WithPtShorthands<Props extends {
    pt?: any;
}> = Props & {
    [key: `pt:${string}`]: any;
};
